name: r5ordclauses_revisions
body:
CREATE VIEW r5ordclauses_revisions
     ( orc_revision,
       orc_act_rev,
       orc_order,
       orc_order_org,
       orc_clause )
AS
SELECT    0,
          ord_revision,
          orc_order,
          orc_order_org,
          orc_clause
   FROM   r5ordclauses, r5orders
   WHERE  ord_code = orc_order
   AND    ord_org  = orc_order_org
   UNION
   SELECT ocr_revision,
          ocr_revision,
          ocr_order,
          ocr_order_org,
          ocr_clause
   FROM   r5ordclauserevs

0

name: R5ORDREALLOC
body:
CREATE VIEW R5ORDREALLOC 
      ( ORA_EVENT,
        ORA_ACT, 
        ORA_EVENT_ORG, 
        ORA_ORDER, 
        ORA_ORDLINE, 
        ORA_ORDER_ORG, 
        ORA_PART, 
        ORA_PART_ORG, 
        ORA_LOT, 
        ORA_RECVQTY,  
        ORA_HOLDQTY, 
        ORA_ISSUEQTY ) 
AS 
SELECT  
 trl_event ora_event,
 trl_act  ora_act,
 e.evt_org ora_event_org,
 trl_order ora_order,
 trl_ordline ora_ordline,
 trl_order_org ora_order_org,
 trl_part ora_part,
 trl_part_org ora_part_org,
 isnull(trl_lot, N'*')  ora_lot,
 SUM(trl_qty * CASE trl_rtype   WHEN N'RECV' THEN 1 
								WHEN N'RETN' THEN -1
								ELSE 0 END )    ora_recvqty,
						
 SUM(trl_qty * CASE trl_rtype   WHEN N'RECV' THEN 
												CASE WHEN trl_store is null THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
								WHEN N'I' THEN
												CASE WHEN trl_store is null THEN 0 ELSE -1 END	
								WHEN N'RETN' THEN
												CASE WHEN trl_store is null THEN 0 ELSE -1 END
								ELSE 0 END)		  ora_holdqty,
				
SUM(trl_qty * CASE trl_rtype 	WHEN N'I' THEN 1
								WHEN N'RECV' THEN 
												CASE WHEN trl_store is null THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
								WHEN N'RETN' THEN
												CASE WHEN trl_store is null THEN -1 ELSE 0 END
								ELSE 0 END)		  ora_issueqty
FROM    r5translines tl, r5events e, r5transactions tr
WHERE   trl_event IS NOT NULL
AND     trl_act   IS NOT NULL
AND     trl_order IS NOT NULL
AND     trl_object IS NULL
AND     trl_io = 0
AND     trl_event = evt_code
AND     trl_trans = tra_code
AND     tra_rstatus = N'A'
GROUP BY trl_event, trl_event, trl_act, trl_order, trl_ordline, trl_order_org,
         trl_part, trl_part_org, isnull(trl_lot,N'*'), e.evt_org

0

name: r5outstandingissues
body:
CREATE VIEW r5outstandingissues
			( tra_pers,
			  trl_part,
			  trl_part_org,
			  par_kit,
			  trl_object,
			  trl_object_org,
			  trl_qty,
			  trl_lot )
AS
SELECT 
 tra_pers,
 trl_part,
 trl_part_org,
 par_kit,
 trl_object,
 trl_object_org,
 SUM( trl_qty ),
 trl_lot
 FROM   r5parts, r5transactions, r5translines, r5events, r5personnel
 WHERE  trl_trans = tra_code
 AND    trl_part = par_code
 AND    trl_part_org = par_org
 AND    trl_rtype = 'I'
 AND    tra_torentity = 'EVNT'
 AND    tra_pers IS NOT NULL
 AND    evt_object = per_object
 AND    evt_object_org = per_object_org
 AND    tra_tocode = evt_code
 AND    per_code = tra_pers
 GROUP BY tra_pers, trl_part, trl_part_org, par_kit, trl_object, trl_object_org, trl_lot
 HAVING SUM( trl_qty ) > 0 
 
0

name: r5outstandingtoolissues
body:
CREATE VIEW r5outstandingtoolissues( par_tool, trl_part, trl_part_org, trl_store, tra_org,
       tra_pers, per_desc, trl_event, trl_act, trl_object, trl_object_org, trl_qty ) AS
SELECT par_tool, trl_part, trl_part_org, trl_store, tra_org, 
       tra_pers, per_desc, trl_event, trl_act, trl_object, trl_object_org, SUM( trl_qty )
FROM   r5parts, r5translines, r5transactions
       LEFT OUTER JOIN r5personnel ON tra_pers = per_code 
WHERE  trl_trans = tra_code
AND    trl_part = par_code
AND    trl_part_org = par_org
AND    trl_rtype IN ( N'I', N'RR' )
AND    par_tool IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY par_tool, trl_part, trl_part_org, trl_store, tra_org, 
      tra_pers, per_desc, trl_event, trl_act, trl_object, trl_object_org
HAVING SUM( trl_qty ) > 0

  SET    plo_changed = '-' 
  WHERE  plo_changed = '+'
  
  /* for cloned screens, set the parent page */
  UPDATE t
  SET    plo_parentpage = f.fun_application
  FROM   r5pagelayout t, r5functions f
  WHERE  t.plo_pagename = f.fun_code
  AND    f.fun_application IS NOT NULL
  AND    f.fun_application <> 'BSUGRD' 

  UPDATE t
  SET    plo_parentpage = f.fun_application
  FROM   r5pagelayout t, r5functions f
  WHERE  t.plo_pagename LIKE f.fun_code+'%'
  AND    SUBSTRING( plo_pagename, 1, CHARINDEX( '_', plo_pagename ) - 1 ) = fun_code 
  AND    CHARINDEX( '_', plo_pagename ) > 0
  AND    f.fun_application IS NOT NULL
  AND    f.fun_application <> 'BSUGRD' 
  
  /* mark the records that have been changed by screen designer */
  UPDATE t
  SET    plo_changed = '+'
  FROM   r5pagelayout t, r5defaultpagelayout d
  WHERE  d.pld_pagename = ISNULL( t.plo_parentpage, t.plo_pagename ) 
  AND    d.pld_elementid = t.plo_elementid
  AND    ( t.plo_presentinjsp                  <> pld_presentinjsp OR 
           ISNULL( t.plo_attribute, '#' )      <> ISNULL( d.pld_attribute, '#' ) OR 
           ISNULL( t.plo_fieldcontainer, '#' ) <> ISNULL( d.pld_fieldcontainer, '#' ) OR 
           ISNULL( t.plo_fieldgroup, -999 )    <> ISNULL( d.pld_fieldgroup, -999 ) OR 
           ISNULL( t.plo_tabindex, -999 )      <> ISNULL( d.pld_tabindex, -999 ) OR
           t.plo_defaultvalue  IS NOT NULL )

  ALTER TABLE r5pagelayout ENABLE TRIGGER PREUPD2_PLO


END

create function R5PARTISSUEDQTY ( @sEvent    nvarchar(30) , @sPart nvarchar(30), @sPartOrg nvarchar(15))
returns integer
as
	begin
		declare @nResult		integer

		SELECT @nResult = SUM(coalesce(l.trl_qty, 0))
		FROM   r5translines l
		WHERE  l.trl_event    = @sEvent
		AND    l.trl_part     = @sPart
		AND    l.trl_part_org = @sPartOrg
		AND    l.trl_rtype    = N'I'
		AND    l.trl_io       = -1
  
		set @nResult = coalesce (@nResult, 0)

		return (@nResult)
	end

name: dbo.R5PARTSUPPRETN
body:
CREATE VIEW dbo.R5PARTSUPPRETN
(TRA_CODE, TRL_ORDER, TRL_ORDER_ORG, TRL_ORDLINE, TRL_PART,
 TRL_PART_ORG, TRL_PRICE, TRL_OBJECT, TRL_OBJECT_ORG, TRL_QTY,
 ORL_CURR, ORL_ORDQTY, TRL_BIN, TRL_LOT, PAR_BYASSET, PAR_UOM,
 TRL_DIRECT, AVAILABLEQTY, ORL_RTYPE, ORG_CURR, ORL_RELATEDWO, EVT_MEQ)
AS
select d.tra_code,
	d.trl_order,
	d.trl_order_org,
	d.trl_ordline,
	d.trl_part,
	d.trl_part_org,
	d.trl_price,
	d.trl_object,
	d.trl_object_org,
	(CASE WHEN d.orl_rtype = N'PD'THEN  dbo.o7matret( trl_order + N'#' + d.trl_order_org + N'#' + CAST(d.trl_ordline AS NVARCHAR(8)), d.orl_event, tra_fromrentity, trl_part, trl_part_org, trl_lot, d.orl_relatedwo, d.tra_advice)
		ELSE (CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN qty > (StockQty-ReservedQty) THEN (StockQty-ReservedQty)
						ELSE qty
						END) > isnull(BinStockQty,0) THEN isnull(BinStockQty,0)
				ELSE (CASE WHEN qty > (StockQty-ReservedQty) THEN (StockQty-ReservedQty)
					ELSE qty
					END)
				END)
	END) trl_qty,
	ordline.orl_curr,
	ordline.orl_ordqty,
	d.trl_bin,
	d.trl_lot,
	par_byasset,
	par_uom,
	(CASE d.orl_rtype WHEN N'PD' THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END ) orl_direct,
	BinStockQty,
	d.orl_rtype,
	d.org_curr,
	d.orl_relatedwo,
	CASE WHEN COALESCE( e1.evt_multiequip, N'-' ) = N'-' THEN NULL 
		 ELSE CASE ordline.orl_relatedwo WHEN NULL THEN N'All' WHEN d.orl_event THEN N'Header' ELSE e2.evt_object END END
from
( select c.*,
	(SELECT isnull( SUM( r.res_allqty ), 0 )
		FROM r5reservations r
		 WHERE r.res_part = trl_part
		 AND r.res_part_org = trl_part_org
		AND r.res_store = tra_fromcode
		AND ( orl_act IS NULL
		OR r.res_event <> orl_event
		OR r.res_act <> orl_act )) ReservedQty,
			(SELECT isnull( s.sto_qty, 0 )
				FROM   r5stock s
				WHERE  s.sto_part  = trl_part
				AND    s.sto_part_org  = trl_part_org
				AND    s.sto_store  = tra_fromcode) StockQty,
					(SELECT isnull( s.bis_qty, 0 )
						FROM   r5binstock s
						WHERE s.bis_part = trl_part
						AND s.bis_part_org = trl_part_org
						AND s.bis_store = tra_fromcode
						AND s.bis_bin = isnull(trl_bin, N'*')
						AND s.bis_lot = isnull(trl_lot,'*')) BinStockQty
from
( select
	tra_code,
	tra_fromcode,
	tra_fromrentity,
	trl_order,
	trl_order_org,
	trl_ordline,
	trl_part,
	trl_part_org,
	trl_price,
	trl_object,
	trl_object_org,
	SUM(( CASE trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * trl_qty ) qty,
	isnull(trl_bin, CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'PS' THEN N'*' ELSE NULL END)  trl_bin,
	isnull(trl_lot,CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'PS' THEN N'*'ELSE NULL END) trl_lot,
	par_byasset,
	par_uom,
	(CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'PD' THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END ) orl_direct,
	orl_act,
	orl_event,
	orl_rtype,
	orl_relatedwo,
	org_curr,
	tra_advice
from
( SELECT
	tra_code,
	tra_org,
	tra_fromrentity,
	tra_order,
	tra_order_org,
	tra_fromcode,
	tra_advice,
    tra_relatedwo
    FROM    r5transactions) A,
( SELECT
	trl_order,
	trl_order_org,
	trl_ordline,
	trl_part,
	trl_line,
	trl_part_org,
	trl_price,
	trl_object,
	trl_object_org,
	orl_curr,
	orl_ordqty,
	orl_costcode,
	orl_project,
	orl_projbud,
	orl_event,
	orl_act,
	orl_relatedwo,
	ISNULL(obj_bin, trl_bin) trl_bin,
	ISNULL(obj_lot, trl_lot) trl_lot,
	orl_rtype,
	par_byasset,
	par_uom,
	orl_req,
	orl_reqline,
	obj_rstatus,
	obj_parent,
	obj_location,
	obj_store,
	obj_code,
    obj_org,
	orl_order_org,
	orl_order,
	trl_qty,
	trl_rtype,
	org_curr
FROM   (((((r5orderlines JOIN r5parts ON orl_part = par_code AND orl_part_org = par_org)
		JOIN r5translines ON orl_order = trl_order AND orl_order_org	  = trl_order_org AND orl_ordline = trl_ordline)
		JOIN r5transactions ON tra_code = trl_trans)
		LEFT JOIN r5objects ON trl_object = obj_code AND trl_object_org  = obj_org) JOIN r5organization on tra_org = org_code)
WHERE orl_rtype IN ( N'PD', N'PS', N'RE')
	AND NOT ( orl_rtype = 'PD' AND trl_rtype = 'I' AND trl_io = 0 )
	AND tra_rstatus = N'A') B
where
	orl_order = A.tra_order
	AND orl_order_org   = a.tra_order_org
	AND ((orl_event  = (select coalesce(evt_routeparent, evt_code) from r5events where evt_code =A.tra_fromcode)
	AND a.tra_fromrentity =  N'EVNT' )
	OR ( A.tra_fromrentity <> N'EVNT' ) )
	AND isnull( tra_advice, N'%' ) LIKE isnull( A.tra_advice, N'%' )
	AND( ( par_byasset = N'+' AND obj_rstatus = N'B' AND obj_store = A.tra_fromcode)
	OR (par_byasset = N'+' AND obj_rstatus =  N'C' AND obj_store = A.tra_fromcode )
	OR (par_byasset = '+' AND obj_rstatus =  'T' AND EXISTS
              ( SELECT 'x' FROM r5transtock WHERE  tst_object = obj_code
                AND tst_object_org = obj_org AND tst_store = A.tra_fromcode AND tst_torentity  = 'EVNT' ) )
	OR ( par_byasset = N'+'
	AND obj_rstatus = N'I'
	AND obj_parent IS NULL
	AND obj_location IS NULL )
	OR par_byasset = N'-' )
    AND coalesce(A.tra_relatedwo,N'#') = CASE a.tra_fromrentity WHEN N'STOR' THEN N'#' ELSE coalesce(orl_relatedwo, N'#') END
GROUP BY
	tra_code,
	trl_order,
	trl_order_org,
	trl_ordline,
	trl_part,
	trl_part_org,
	trl_bin,
	trl_lot,
	trl_price,
	trl_object,
	trl_object_org,
	orl_costcode,
	orl_project,
	orl_projbud,
	orl_event,
	orl_act,
	orl_relatedwo,
	orl_rtype,
	par_byasset,
	par_uom,
	orl_req,
	orl_reqline,
	tra_fromrentity,
	tra_fromcode,
	org_curr,
	tra_advice
    HAVING  SUM( CASE trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * trl_qty ) > 0
) C
) D,
r5orderlines ordline
left outer join r5events e1 on (e1.evt_code = ordline.orl_event)
left outer join r5events e2 on (e2.evt_code = ordline.orl_relatedwo)
WHERE trl_order = ORL_ORDER
AND trl_order_org = ORL_ORDER_ORG
AND trl_ordline = ORL_ORDLINE
0

name: R5PARTTRANSACTED
body:
CREATE VIEW R5PARTTRANSACTED ( 
       pat_event, 
       pat_act, 
       pat_part, 
       pat_part_org, 
       pat_qty, 
       pat_uom ) AS 
	SELECT trl.trl_event, 
		trl.trl_act, 
		trl.trl_part, 
		trl.trl_part_org, 
		SUM( coalesce( trl.trl_origqty, trl.trl_qty) * CASE trl_io WHEN 0 
										THEN CASE trl_rtype WHEN N'RETN' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END
										ELSE -trl_io 
										END),
		p.par_uom
	FROM   r5translines trl, 
		r5transactions tra,  
		r5parts p
	WHERE  tra.tra_code = trl.trl_trans
		AND  ((tra.tra_rtype = N'I'
		AND   tra.tra_fromrentity = N'STOR'
		AND   tra.tra_torentity = N'EVNT' )
		OR  (tra.tra_rtype = N'RECV'
		AND   tra.tra_fromrentity = N'COMP'
		AND   tra.tra_torentity = N'EVNT' )
		OR  (tra.tra_rtype = N'RETN'
		AND   tra.tra_fromrentity = N'EVNT'
		AND   tra.tra_torentity = N'COMP' ))
		AND   trl.trl_part = par_code
		AND   trl.trl_part_org = par_org  
	GROUP BY trl.trl_event,
		trl.trl_act,
		trl.trl_part,
		trl.trl_part_org,
		p.par_uom

name: R5PARTUSAGE
body:
CREATE VIEW R5PARTUSAGE
     ( pu_event,
       pu_job_type,
       pu_obtype,
       pu_object,
       pu_object_org,
       pu_date,
       pu_part,
       pu_part_org,
       pu_qty,
       pu_price,
       pu_metuom,
       pu_failureusage )
AS
SELECT
   e.evt_code,
   e.evt_jobtype,
   o.eob_obtype,
   o.eob_object,
   o.eob_object_org,
   l.trl_date,
   l.trl_part,
   l.trl_part_org,
   sum( l.trl_qty ),
   l.trl_price,
   e.evt_metuom,
   e.evt_failureusage
FROM    r5events        e,
        r5eventobjects  o,
        r5transactions  t,
        r5translines    l
WHERE   t.tra_rtype     = N'I'
AND     e.evt_code      = t.tra_tocode
AND     t.tra_code      = l.trl_trans
AND     o.eob_event     = e.evt_code
GROUP BY
   e.evt_code,
   e.evt_jobtype,
   o.eob_obtype,
   o.eob_object,
   o.eob_object_org,
   l.trl_date,
   l.trl_part,
   l.trl_part_org,
   l.trl_price,
   e.evt_metuom,
   e.evt_failureusage
UNION
SELECT
   a.evt_code,
   a.evt_jobtype,
   a.eob_obtype,
   a.eob_object,
   a.eob_object_org,
   a.trl_date,
   a.trl_part,
   a.trl_part_org, 
   sum( CASE a.tra_rtype WHEN 'RETN' THEN a.trl_qty * -1 ELSE a.trl_qty END ),
   a.trl_price,
   a.evt_metuom,
   a.evt_failureusage
FROM 
(SELECT
   e.evt_code,
   e.evt_jobtype,
   o.eob_obtype,
   o.eob_object,
   o.eob_object_org,
   l.trl_date,
   l.trl_part,
   l.trl_part_org, 
   t.tra_rtype ,
   l.trl_qty, 
   l.trl_price,
   e.evt_metuom,
   e.evt_failureusage
FROM    r5events        e,
        r5eventobjects  o,
        r5transactions  t,
        r5translines    l
WHERE ( t.tra_rtype     = N'RECV' AND  t.tra_torentity = N'EVNT'   AND e.evt_code      = t.tra_tocode)
AND     t.tra_code      = l.trl_trans
AND     o.eob_event     = e.evt_code
UNION 
SELECT
   e.evt_code,
   e.evt_jobtype,
   o.eob_obtype,
   o.eob_object,
   o.eob_object_org,
   l.trl_date,
   l.trl_part,
   l.trl_part_org, 
   t.tra_rtype ,
   l.trl_qty, 
   l.trl_price,
   e.evt_metuom,
   e.evt_failureusage
FROM    r5events        e,
        r5eventobjects  o,
        r5transactions  t,
        r5translines    l
WHERE ( t.tra_rtype     = N'RETN' AND  t.tra_fromrentity = N'EVNT' AND e.evt_code      = t.tra_fromcode )
AND     t.tra_code      = l.trl_trans
AND     o.eob_event     = e.evt_code
) a
GROUP BY
   a.evt_code,
   a.evt_jobtype,
   a.eob_obtype,
   a.eob_object,
   a.eob_object_org,
   a.trl_date,
   a.trl_part,
   a.trl_part_org,
   a.trl_price,
   a.evt_metuom,
   a.evt_failureusage

CREATE VIEW R5PERQUALIFICATIONS AS
SELECT  DISTINCT p.per_code   pqu_person,
         q.qua_code   pqu_qualification,
         q.qua_desc   pqu_desc,
         p.per_org    pqu_org,
         p.per_class  pqu_class,
         p.per_trade  pqu_trade,
         t.trd_class  pqu_tradeclass,
         per_mrc      pqu_mrc,
         NULL         pqu_task,
         0            pqu_revision
FROM
	   r5tradequalifications tq,
	   r5personnel p,
	   r5qualifications q,
	   r5trades t
WHERE  q.qua_code   = tq.trq_qualification
AND    tq.trq_trade = p.per_trade
AND    t.trd_code   = p.per_trade
AND    tq.trq_qualification NOT IN(
   SELECT pq.pqu_qualification
   FROM r5personnelqualifications pq
   WHERE p.per_code = pq.pqu_person
   AND  ( isnull( pq.pqu_tempdisqualified, N'-' ) = N'-'
          AND  getdate() <= pq.pqu_expiration ) )
UNION
SELECT  DISTINCT p.per_code     pqu_person,
                 q.qua_code     pqu_qualification,
                 q.qua_desc     pqu_desc,
                 p.per_org      pqu_org,
                 p.per_class    pqu_class,
                 p.per_trade    pqu_trade,
                 tr.trd_class   pqu_tradeclass,
                 per_mrc        pqu_mrc,
                 tskq.tqu_task  pqu_task,
                 tskq.tqu_revision  pqu_revision
FROM
   r5tradequalifications tq,
   r5personnel p,
   r5qualifications q,
   r5tasks t,
   r5taskqualifications tskq,
   r5trades tr
WHERE  q.qua_code = tskq.tqu_qualification
AND    t.tsk_trade = p.per_trade
AND    t.tsk_code = tskq.tqu_task
AND    t.tsk_revision = tskq.tqu_revision
AND    tr.trd_code = p.per_trade
AND    tskq.tqu_revision = (
   SELECT MAX( tq1.tqu_revision )
   FROM   r5taskqualifications tq1
   WHERE  tq1.tqu_task          = tskq.tqu_task
   AND    tq1.tqu_qualification = tskq.tqu_qualification
   GROUP BY tq1.tqu_task )
AND    tskq.tqu_qualification NOT IN (
   SELECT pq1.pqu_qualification
   FROM   r5personnelqualifications pq1
   WHERE  p.per_code                         = pq1.pqu_person
   AND  ( isnull(pq1.pqu_tempdisqualified, N'-') = N'-'
          AND  getdate() <= pq1.pqu_expiration) )

(TRL_EVENT, TRL_ACT, TRL_PART, TRL_PART_ORG, TRL_STORE, 
 TRL_LINE, TRL_DIRECT, TRL_MATLIST, TRL_MATLISTREV)
AS 

SELECT
   coalesce( e.evt_routeparent, l.trl_event),
   l.trl_act,
   l.trl_part,
   l.trl_part_org,
   l.trl_store,
   0 line,
   null direct,
   null matlist,
   null matlistrev

       r5translines l,

AND    t.tra_torentity   = N'EVNT'
AND    t.tra_fromrentity = CASE l.trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN N'COMP' ELSE t.tra_fromrentity  END
AND    l.trl_rtype IN ( N'I', N'RR', N'RECV' )
AND    e.evt_code = l.trl_event
UNION
SELECT
   l.trl_event,
   l.trl_act,
   l.trl_part,
   l.trl_part_org,
   l.trl_store,
   0 line,
   null direct,
   null matlist,
   null matlistrev
FROM   r5transactions t,
       r5translines l,
       r5events e
WHERE  l.trl_trans       = t.tra_code
AND    (t.tra_torentity   = N'EVNT' OR t.tra_torentity   = N'STOR')
AND    t.tra_fromrentity = CASE l.trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN N'COMP' ELSE t.tra_fromrentity END
AND    l.trl_rtype IN ( N'I', N'RR', N'RECV' )
AND    e.evt_code = l.trl_event
AND    e.evt_routeparent IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT r.res_event,
   r.res_act,
   r.res_part,
   r.res_part_org,
   r.res_store,
   0 line,
   null direct,
   null matlist,
   null matlistrev
FROM   r5reservations r
UNION
SELECT
   a.act_event,
   a.act_act,
   m.mlp_part,
   m.mlp_part_org,
   CASE isnull(str_org,e.evt_org) WHEN e.evt_org THEN d.mrc_store ELSE null END,
   m.mlp_line line,
   m.mlp_direct direct,
   m.mlp_matlist matlist,
   m.mlp_matlrev matlistrev
FROM   r5matlparts m,
       r5objects o LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events e1 ON ( o.obj_code = e1.evt_object AND o.obj_org  = e1.evt_object_org ),
       r5events e,
       r5activities a,
	   r5stores s RIGHT OUTER JOIN
       r5mrcs d ON ( d.mrc_store   = s.str_code )
WHERE  a.act_matlist = m.mlp_matlist
AND    a.act_matlrev = m.mlp_matlrev
AND    a.act_event   = e.evt_code
AND    e.evt_mrc     = d.mrc_code
AND    dbo.o7checkmatch( mlp_equipfilter, obj_checklistfilter ) = '+'
AND ( ( isnull(m.mlp_code, isnull(e.evt_object,N'!@#$%')) = isnull(e.evt_object,N'!@#$%')
AND isnull(m.mlp_code_org, isnull(e.evt_object_org,N'!@#$%')) = isnull(e.evt_object_org,N'!@#$%'))
 OR ( m.mlp_obrtype = N'C'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT obj_code
	              FROM r5objects
				  WHERE obj_code = e.evt_object
				  AND   obj_org = e.evt_object_org
				  AND   obj_category = m.mlp_code) ) )

CREATE VIEW R5PLNTRN 
AS 
	SELECT l.trl_event, l.trl_act, coalesce(l.trl_issuedpart,l.trl_part) trl_part, l.trl_part_org, l.trl_store, 0 trl_line, null trl_direct,
		   null trl_matlist, null trl_matlistrev
	FROM   r5transactions t, 
		   r5translines l
	WHERE  l.trl_trans       = t.tra_code
	AND    t.tra_torentity   = N'EVNT'
	AND    t.tra_fromrentity = CASE l.trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN N'COMP' ELSE t.tra_fromrentity END
	AND    l.trl_rtype IN ( N'I', N'RR', N'RECV' )
	UNION
	SELECT a.act_event, a.act_act, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org, CASE isnull(str_org,e.evt_org) WHEN e.evt_org THEN d.mrc_store ELSE null END,
		   m.mlp_line line, m.mlp_direct direct, m.mlp_matlist matlist, m.mlp_matlrev matlistrev
	FROM   r5matlparts m, 
		   r5events e, 
		   r5activities a, 
		   r5mrcs d LEFT OUTER JOIN r5stores s ON d.mrc_store   = s.str_code
	WHERE  a.act_matlist = m.mlp_matlist
	AND    a.act_matlrev = m.mlp_matlrev
	AND    a.act_event   = e.evt_code
	AND    e.evt_mrc     = d.mrc_code
	AND ( ( isnull(m.mlp_code, isnull(e.evt_object, N'!@#$%')) = isnull(e.evt_object, N'!@#$%')
	AND isnull(m.mlp_code_org, isnull(e.evt_object_org, N'!@#$%')) = isnull(e.evt_object_org, N'!@#$%') )
	OR  ( m.mlp_obrtype = N'C'
		  AND EXISTS (SELECT obj_code
						FROM r5objects
						WHERE obj_code = e.evt_object
						AND   obj_org = e.evt_object_org
						AND   obj_category = m.mlp_code) ) )

body:
CREATE VIEW R5POCALCFIELDVALUES(
	pcf_order, 
	pcf_order_org, 
	pcf_partlines, 
	pcf_servicelines,
	pcf_polines, 
	pcf_totalpartvalue, 
	pcf_totalservicevalue, 
	pcf_totalpovalue, 
	pcf_totaltaxamount, 
	pcf_totalextracharges)
AS
	SELECT ord_code, ord_org,
		SUM( CASE WHEN SUBSTRING( orl_rtype, 1, 1 ) IN ('P','R') THEN 1  ELSE 0 END),
		SUM( CASE WHEN SUBSTRING( orl_rtype, 1, 1 ) = 'S' THEN 1  ELSE 0 END),
		count(*),
		ROUND(CAST(SUM( 
		dbo.f_greatest_number( 
		CASE	WHEN SUBSTRING( orl_rtype, 1, 1 ) IN ('P','R')
			THEN COALESCE(orl_price, 0) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1) *
				( COALESCE(CASE WHEN orl_rstatus IN('C','J') THEN orl_recvqty ELSE orl_ordqty END , 0 ) / COALESCE( orl_multiply, 1 ) )  *
				( 1 - 0.01 * COALESCE( orl_discperc, 0 ) ) + (CASE WHEN orl_rstatus IN('C','J') THEN 0 ELSE (COALESCE(orl_totextra, 0) + COALESCE(orl_tottaxamount, 0)) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) END)
			ELSE 0	
			END , 0 ) ) as numeric(24,6)),2),
		ROUND(CAST(
		SUM( 
		dbo.f_greatest_number( 
		CASE SUBSTRING( orl_rtype, 1, 1 ) 
			WHEN 'S'
			THEN COALESCE(CASE orl_rtype WHEN 'SF' THEN CASE WHEN orl_rstatus IN('C','J') THEN orl_recvvalue ELSE orl_price END ELSE orl_price END, 0) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) *
				( COALESCE( CASE orl_rtype WHEN 'SF' THEN 1 ELSE CASE WHEN orl_rstatus IN('C','J') THEN  orl_recvqty ELSE orl_ordqty END END, 0 ) / COALESCE( orl_multiply, 1 ) ) *
				( 1 - 0.01 * COALESCE( orl_discperc, 0 ) ) + (CASE WHEN orl_rstatus IN('C','J') THEN 0 ELSE (COALESCE(orl_totextra, 0) + COALESCE(orl_tottaxamount, 0)) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) END)
			ELSE 0 
			END , 0 ) ) as numeric(24,6)),2),
		ROUND(CAST(SUM( 
		dbo.f_greatest_number( 
		CASE SUBSTRING( orl_rtype, 1, 1 ) 
			WHEN 'S' 
			THEN COALESCE(CASE orl_rtype WHEN 'SF' THEN CASE WHEN orl_rstatus IN('C','J') THEN orl_recvvalue ELSE orl_price END ELSE orl_price END, 0) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) *
				( COALESCE( CASE orl_rtype WHEN 'SF' THEN 1 ELSE CASE WHEN orl_rstatus IN('C','J') THEN  orl_recvqty ELSE orl_ordqty END END, 0 ) / COALESCE( orl_multiply, 1 ) ) *
				( 1 - 0.01 * COALESCE( orl_discperc, 0 ) ) + (CASE WHEN orl_rstatus IN('C','J') THEN 0 ELSE (COALESCE(orl_totextra, 0) + COALESCE(orl_tottaxamount, 0)) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) END)
			ELSE COALESCE(orl_price, 0) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1) *
				( COALESCE(CASE WHEN orl_rstatus IN('C','J') THEN orl_recvqty ELSE orl_ordqty END , 0 ) / COALESCE( orl_multiply, 1 ) ) *
				( 1 - 0.01 * COALESCE( orl_discperc, 0 ) ) + (CASE WHEN orl_rstatus IN('C','J') THEN 0 ELSE (COALESCE(orl_totextra, 0) + COALESCE(orl_tottaxamount, 0)) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) END)
			END, 0 ) ) as numeric(24,6)) ,2),
		ROUND(CAST(SUM( CASE WHEN orl_rstatus IN('C','J') THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(orl_tottaxamount, 0) / COALESCE(orl_exch, 1) END) as numeric(24,6)) ,2),
		ROUND(CAST(SUM( CASE WHEN orl_rstatus IN('C','J') THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(orl_totextra, 0) / COALESCE(orl_exch, 1) END) as numeric(24,6)) ,2)
	FROM r5orders,r5orderlines
	WHERE ord_code = orl_order 
	AND ord_org = orl_order_org
	GROUP BY ord_code, ord_org

CREATE VIEW R5PPMWINDOWS
     ( ppw_event,
       ppw_ppm,
       ppw_ppmrev,
       ppw_obtype,
       ppw_object,
       ppw_object_org,
       ppw_target,
       ppw_meter,
       ppw_jobtype,
       ppw_status,
       ppw_priority,
       ppw_okdate,
       ppw_neardate,
       ppw_gendate,
       ppw_okval,
       ppw_nearval,
       ppw_genval,       
	   ppw_okval2,
       ppw_nearval2,
       ppw_genval2 )
AS
(
       SELECT  e.evt_code, e.evt_ppm, e.evt_ppmrev, e.evt_obtype, e.evt_object,
	         e.evt_object_org, e.evt_target, e.evt_meterdue, e.evt_jobtype,
               e.evt_status, e.evt_priority,

			CASE dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE(isnull(dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE((e.evt_okwinend), N'DD'), CONVERT(datetime, N'01-01-1910', 110)), dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(getdate(), N'DD') )
			WHEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE((e.evt_okwinend),'dd') THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END,

			CASE DATEDIFF(day, dbo.F_LEAST_DATE(dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(e.evt_genwinstart, N'DD') - 1, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(getdate(), N'DD')),
						dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE((e.evt_nearwinstart), N'DD'), dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(getdate(),N'DD') ))
				 WHEN 0 THEN '+'
							ELSE '-' END,

			CASE dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(e.evt_genwinstart, N'DD'), dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(getdate(), N'DD') )
			WHEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(getdate(), N'DD') THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END,

			CASE dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER(isnull(e.evt_okwinendval,0), isnull(o.oud_totalusage,0))
			WHEN 
				CASE isnull(e.evt_okwinendval,0) WHEN 0 THEN -99 ELSE e.evt_okwinendval END
			THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END,

			CASE dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER(isnull(e.evt_nearwinbegval,0), isnull(o.oud_totalusage,0)) -
				 dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER(isnull(e.evt_genwinbegval,0) - 1, isnull(o.oud_totalusage,0))
			WHEN 0 THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END,

			CASE dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER(isnull(e.evt_genwinbegval,0), isnull(o.oud_totalusage,0))
			WHEN CASE isnull(o.oud_totalusage,0) WHEN 0 THEN -99 ELSE o.oud_totalusage END
			THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END,

			CASE dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER(isnull(e.evt_okwinendval2,0), isnull(o.oud_totalusage,0))
			WHEN CASE isnull(e.evt_okwinendval2,0) WHEN 0 THEN -99 ELSE e.evt_okwinendval2 END
			THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END,

			CASE dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER(isnull(e.evt_nearwinbegval2,0), isnull(o.oud_totalusage,0)) -
				 dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER(isnull(e.evt_genwinbegval2,0) - 1, isnull(o.oud_totalusage,0))
			WHEN 0 THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END,

			CASE dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER(isnull(e.evt_genwinbegval2,0), isnull(o.oud_totalusage,0))
			WHEN CASE isnull(o.oud_totalusage,0) WHEN 0 THEN -99 ELSE o.oud_totalusage END
			THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END 

       FROM  r5events e LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objusagedefs o
       ON (e.evt_metuom = o.oud_uom AND e.evt_object = o.oud_object AND e.evt_object_org = o.oud_object_org)
       LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objusagedefs o2
       ON (e.evt_metuom2 = o2.oud_uom AND e.evt_object = o2.oud_object AND e.evt_object_org = o2.oud_object_org) 
       WHERE   e.evt_rstatus   <> N'C'
   )

CREATE VIEW R5PROPERTIESEVT
(APR_PROPERTY, APR_CLASS, APR_CLASS_ORG, PRO_TYPE, PRO_DESC,
 APR_UOM, PRO_CODE, DES_LANG, APR_RENTITY, R5_DEFORG,
 PCODE, PRV_VALUE, PRV_NVALUE, PRV_DVALUE)
AS (
SELECT   a.apr_property,
                 a.apr_class,
                 a.apr_class_org,
                 p.pro_type,
                 ISNULL(d.des_text, p.pro_text) pro_desc,
                 a.apr_uom,
                 p.pro_code,
		d.des_lang, a.apr_rentity,
		i.ins_desc R5_DEFORG,
		E.EVT_CODE PCODE,
		V.PRV_VALUE, V.PRV_NVALUE, V.PRV_DVALUE
FROM ((R5EVENTS E 	INNER JOIN R5INSTALL I
		ON (I.INS_CODE = 'DEFORG')
	INNER JOIN R5ADDPROPERTIES A
		ON (    ( a.apr_class = N'*' AND a.apr_class_org = I.INS_DESC )   OR
              ( a.apr_class = N'*' AND a.apr_class_org = E.EVT_org )    OR
              ( a.apr_class = N'*' AND a.apr_class_org = E.EVT_class_org )  OR
              ( a.apr_class = E.EVT_class AND a.apr_class_org = E.EVT_class_org ) )
	INNER JOIN R5PROPERTIES P
		ON (p.pro_code     = a.apr_property)
	) LEFT JOIN R5DESCRIPTIONS D
		ON d.des_rentity = N'PROM' AND d.des_code = p.pro_code
	) LEFT JOIN R5PROPERTYVALUES V
		ON (A.APR_PROPERTY = V.PRV_PROPERTY AND A.APR_RENTITY = V.PRV_RENTITY AND
		    A.APR_CLASS = V.PRV_CLASS AND A.APR_CLASS_ORG = V.PRV_CLASS_ORG AND
		    E.EVT_CODE = V.PRV_CODE)
WHERE A.APR_RENTITY = N'EVNT'
AND	a.apr_wodisp     = N'+'
)

 APR_UOM, PRO_CODE, DES_LANG, APR_RENTITY, R5_DEFORG,

		ON (p.pro_code     = a.apr_property)

create function R5REPORLCOL_GET_HIERARCHY (@sCode nvarchar(30), @sOrg nvarchar(15))
returns @tReturn table( loc_code nvarchar(50) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sCurrentOrg	nvarchar(15)
		
	declare @tStack table ( loc_code nvarchar(30), loc_org nvarchar(15), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select loc_code, loc_org, 1 from r5locations where loc_code = @sCode and loc_org = @sOrg
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = loc_code, 
							@sCurrentOrg = loc_org
						from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode + N'#' + @sCurrentOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel and loc_code = @sCurrentCode and loc_org = @sCurrentOrg
					insert into @tStack select loc_code, loc_org, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5locations
										 where loc_parent = @sCurrentCode and
												loc_parent_org = @sCurrentOrg
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create function R5REP_BZSNAP_DESC(  @sLang          nvarchar(2),
                                    @sEntity        nvarchar(4),
                                    @sEntcode        nvarchar(256),
                                    @sEntparentcode nvarchar(256),
                                    @sEntorg        nvarchar(15),
                                    @sRtype         nvarchar(256),
                                    @sUtype         nvarchar(256))
returns nvarchar(255)
as
begin
    declare @sVentity   nvarchar(256)
    declare @sVcode     nvarchar(256)
    declare @sVdesc     nvarchar(255)
    declare @sVrentity  nvarchar(256)
    declare @sVorg      nvarchar(256)

    declare @nPos       int
    
    if charindex( N'%', @sEntcode ) <> 0
    return( null )

    set @sVrentity = null

    --initialize @sVorg to empty string since itis used in concatenations later
    set @sVorg = N''

    if @sEntorg is not null
        set @sVorg = N'#' + @sEntorg

    select @sVrentity = ent_rentity
    from r5entities
    where ent_entity = @sEntity

    if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        set @sVrentity = @sEntity

    if @sVrentity in (N'TASK', N'PPM', N'MATL', N'INSP', N'QUOT', N'SCAT')
        set @sVcode = substring( @sEntcode, 1, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode, 1) - 1) + @sVorg
    else
        begin   
            if @sVrentity = N'EAL'
                begin
                    set @nPos = charindex( N'#', @sEntcode, 1) + 1
                    set @sVcode = substring( @sEntcode, @nPos, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode, @nPos) - @nPos) + @sVorg
                end
            else
                set @sVcode = @sEntcode + @sVorg
        end

    if @sVrentity in (N'RETN', N'RECV', N'STOS') 
        set @sVrentity = N'TRAN'

    if @sVrentity = N'INSP'
        set @sVrentity = N'DOCK'
    
    if @sVrentity = N'EAL'
        begin
            set @sVentity = substring( @sEntcode, 1, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode, 1) - 1)

            select @sVrentity = ent_rentity
            from r5entities
            where ent_entity = @sVentity

            if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                set @sVrentity = @sVentity
        end

    if @sEntity = N'INRH'
        set @sVdesc = null
    else
        set @sVdesc = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, @sVrentity, @sVcode, null, null )

    return @sVdesc
end

CREATE FUNCTION R5REP_EQUIP_HIERARCHY_1 (	@sEvtobject		NVARCHAR(30),
											@sEevtobjectorg	NVARCHAR(15))

RETURNS @tReturn TABLE (stc_parent		NVARCHAR(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						stc_parent_org	NVARCHAR(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nLevel					INTEGER
	DECLARE @sCurrentparent			NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @sCurrentparentorg		NVARCHAR(15)
    DECLARE @sRollup                nvarchar(1)
    DECLARE @sChildrtype            nvarchar(4)
    DECLARE @sParentrtype                nvarchar(1)

	DECLARE @tStack	TABLE ( stc_parent		NVARCHAR(30), 
							stc_parent_org	NVARCHAR(15),
							LevelID 		INTEGER )

	SET @nLevel = 1

	INSERT INTO @tStack
		SELECT	stc_parent,
				stc_parent_org,
				@nLevel
		FROM	r5structures s
		WHERE	s.stc_child LIKE @sEvtobject and
                s.stc_child_org LIKE @sEevtobjectorg and
			    (s.stc_rollup = '+' OR s.stc_childrtype = 'L' OR s.stc_parentrtype = 'L')

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCurrentparent	= stc_parent,
							@sCurrentparentorg	= stc_parent_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					
                    insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentparent, @sCurrentparentorg)
					
                    delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_parent = @sCurrentparent and stc_parent_org = @sCurrentparentorg
					
                    insert into @tStack	select	stc_parent,
                                                stc_parent_org,
                                                @nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_child		= @sCurrentparent	and 
												stc_child_org	= @sCurrentparentorg and
                                                (stc_rollup = '+' OR stc_childrtype = 'L' OR stc_parentrtype = 'L'		)
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

CREATE function R5REP_GETFISCALENDDATE (@cORGANIZATION  nvarchar(15) )    
returns datetime  
as  
begin  
	declare @dEndDate datetime  
	declare @dSysDate datetime  
  
	SELECT @dSysDate = DBO.REPGETSYSDATE(@cORGANIZATION)  

	SELECT @dEndDate =  OYE_END FROM R5ORGYEARS   
	WHERE OYE_ORG = @cORGANIZATION AND   
        OYE_START <= @dSysDate AND  
        OYE_END >= @dSysDate   
  
 	IF @dEndDate IS NULL      
   		SELECT @dEndDate = DBO.TO_DATE('31-12-' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEPART(YYYY,@dSysDate)),'DD-MM-YYYY')  
   
    RETURN( @dEndDate )    
end

create function R5REP_GET_PARAM_DESC(@sLang nvarchar(3), @sRentity nvarchar(4),
                          @sCode  nvarchar(60), @sRtype nvarchar(4), @sType nvarchar(4))
returns nvarchar(255)
as
begin

    declare @sChk       nvarchar(4)
    declare @sDeforg    nvarchar(200) --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
    declare @sCod       nvarchar(100)
    declare @sOrg       nvarchar(100)
    declare @sHorg      nvarchar(100)
    declare @sTxt       nvarchar(500)
    declare @sNewcod    nvarchar(100)

    if @sRentity IS NULL 
        RETURN NULL

    if charindex(N'%' , @sCode ) <> 0 
        RETURN NULL
    
    if charindex(N'_' , @sCode) <> 0 
        RETURN NULL
    
    if @sRentity IN ( N'PORD', N'OBJ',  N'CLAS', N'CAT', N'INV', N'PART', N'COMP', N'EIV', N'RMA' ) 
        begin
            set @sDeforg = dbo.o7dflt2( N'DEFORG')
            if charindex( N'#' , @sCode ) > 0 
                begin
                    set @sCod = SUBSTRING( @sCode, 1, charindex( N'#' , @sCode  ) - 1 )
                    set @sOrg = SUBSTRING( @sCode, charindex( N'#', @sCode  ) + 1, len(@sCode) - charindex( N'#', @sCode  ) )
                end
            else
                begin
                    set @sCod = @sCode
                    set @sOrg = @sDeforg
                end

            if @sRentity = N'CAT' 
                set @sOrg = @sDeforg
            else
                begin
                    if dbo.o7getmos( @sRentity ) = N'-' 
                        set @sOrg = @sDeforg
                    else
                        begin
                            set @sTxt = RTRIM(dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(@sLang, @sRentity, @sCode, @sRtype, @sType ) )
                            if @sTxt <> N'?' 
                                    RETURN( N'[ ' + @sTxt + ' ]' )
                            else
                                begin
                                    set @sHorg = @sOrg
                                    if    @sRentity = N'OBJ'  
                                        begin
                                            SELECT @sOrg = obj_org
                                            FROM   r5objects
                                            WHERE  obj_code = @sCod
                                            If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
                                                set @sOrg = @sHorg
                                        end
                                    if @sRentity = N'PORD' 
                                        begin
                                            SELECT @sOrg = ord_org
                                            FROM   r5orders
                                            WHERE  ord_code = @sCod
                                            If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
                                                set @sOrg = @sHorg
                                        end
                                    if @sRentity = N'CLAS' 
                                        begin
                                            SELECT @sOrg = cls_org
                                            FROM   r5classes
                                            WHERE  cls_code = @sCod
                                            AND    cls_rentity = @sRtype
                                            If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
                                                set @sOrg = @sHorg
                                        end
                                    if @sRentity = N'INV'  
                                        begin
                                            SELECT @sOrg = inv_org
                                            FROM   r5invoices
                                            WHERE  inv_code = @sCod
                                            If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
                                                set @sOrg = @sHorg
                                        end
                                    if @sRentity = N'EIV'  
                                        begin
                                            SELECT @sOrg = eiv_org
                                            FROM   r5extinvoices
                                            WHERE  eiv_code = @sCod
                                            If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
                                                set @sOrg = @sHorg
                                        end
                                    if @sRentity = N'PART' 
                                        begin
                                            SELECT @sOrg = par_org
                                            FROM   r5parts
                                            WHERE  par_code = @sCod
                                            If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
                                                set @sOrg = @sHorg
                                        end
                                    if @sRentity = N'COMP' 
                                        begin
                                            SELECT @sOrg = com_org
                                            FROM   r5companies
                                            WHERE  com_code = @sCod
                                            If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
                                                set @sOrg = @sHorg
                                        end
                                    if @sRentity = N'RMA'  
                                        begin
                                            SELECT @sOrg = rma_org
                                            FROM   r5rma
                                            WHERE  rma_code = @sCod
                                            If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
                                                set @sOrg = @sHorg
                                        end
                                end
                        end
                end
            set @sNewcod = @sCod + N'#' + @sOrg
            RETURN( N'[ ' + RTRIM(dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(@sLang, @sRentity, @sNewcod, @sRtype, @sType)) + ' ]')
        end

    RETURN( N'[ ' + RTRIM(dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(@sLang, @sRentity, @sCode, @sRtype, @sType)) + ' ]')
end

CREATE FUNCTION R5REP_LOCATION_HIERARCHY_1 (	@sEvtloc		NVARCHAR(30),
											@sEvtlocorg	NVARCHAR(15))

RETURNS @tReturn TABLE (loc_code		NVARCHAR(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						loc_org	NVARCHAR(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nLevel					INTEGER
	DECLARE @sLocparent			NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @sLocparentorg		NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @sLoccode			NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @sLocorg		    NVARCHAR(15)

	DECLARE @tStack	TABLE ( loc_parent      NVARCHAR(30),
                            loc_parent_org  NVARCHAR(15),
                            loc_code		NVARCHAR(30), 
							loc_org	        NVARCHAR(15),
							LevelID 		INTEGER )

	SET @nLevel = 1

	INSERT INTO @tStack
		SELECT	loc_parent,
                loc_parent_org,
				loc_code,
                loc_org, 
				@nLevel
		FROM	r5locations 
		WHERE	loc_code LIKE @sEvtloc
                and loc_org like @sEvtlocorg

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sLocparent	= loc_parent,
							@sLocparentorg	= loc_parent_org,
                            @sLoccode = loc_code,
                            @sLocorg = loc_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					
                    insert into @tReturn values ( @sLoccode, @sLocorg)
					
                    delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND loc_code = @sLoccode and loc_org = @sLocorg
					
                    insert into @tStack	select	loc_parent,
                                                loc_parent_org,
                                                loc_code,
                                                loc_org, 
                                                @nLevel + 1
										  from	r5locations
										 where	loc_code		= @sLocparent	and 
												loc_org	= @sLocparentorg 
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

CREATE FUNCTION R5REP_NEXTDAY(@dDate DATETIME, @startDay INTEGER) RETURNS DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @nextDate DATETIME,
		@currDay INTEGER
	
SET @currDay = datepart(dw,@dDate)


/* 1=SUN, 2=MON, 3=TUE, 4=WED, 5=THU, 6=FRI, 7=SAT, NOT(1,2,3,4,5,6,7)=SUN */
IF (@startDay < 1 or @startDay > 7)
	SET @startDay = 1


IF (@startDay <= @currDay)
	SET @nextDate = dateadd(dd,7 - @currDay + @startDay, @dDate)
ELSE
	SET @nextDate = dateadd(dd, @startDay - @currDay, @dDate)
	
RETURN @nextDate
END

name: dbo.R5REP_REPFMTNUM2
body:
create function dbo.R5REP_REPFMTNUM2(@usr NVARCHAR(255), @nNumtofmt NVARCHAR(100))
returns nvarchar(100)
as
begin
    Declare @sTdec_num       NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @sFloor_num      NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @sDec_num        NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @sFmt_floor      NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @sFmt_num        NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @nFloorcnt       INTEGER
    Declare @nSignVal        INTEGER
    Declare @nNum            NUMERIC(38,12)
    Declare @sAfterdecchar   NVARCHAR(1)
    Declare @nDec_place      INTEGER
    Declare @sDec_sepr       NVARCHAR(3)
    Declare @sGrp_sepr       NVARCHAR(1)
    Declare @nGrp_digit      INTEGER
    Declare @sNeg_sym        NVARCHAR(1)
    Declare @sTemp           NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @nNumtoformat    NUMERIC(38,12)
    Declare @ni              INTEGER

        SELECT @nDec_place=coalesce(LOC_FRACTDIGITS,0), @sDec_sepr=LOC_DECSYM, @sGrp_sepr=LOC_GRPSYM, 
                  @nGrp_digit=coalesce(LOC_GRPDIGITS,0), @sNeg_sym=coalesce(LOC_NEGSYM,'-')
        FROM R5LOCALE
        WHERE LOC_CODE = (Select coalesce(USR_LOCALE,'NAMERICA') FROM R5USERS WHERE USR_CODE = @usr)

        SET @sFmt_num = @nNumtofmt

        IF isnumeric(@nNumtofmt) = 1
        BEGIN
            SET @nNumtoformat = @nNumtofmt
            SET @ni = 0
            SET @sAfterdecchar = N'0'
            SET @nSignVal = SIGN(@nNumtoformat)
            SET @nNum = @nNumtoformat

            IF @nSignVal = -1
                SET @nNum = -1 * @nNumtoformat

            IF @nDec_place = 0 
                SET @sFloor_num = ROUND(@nNum,0)
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SET @sFloor_num = FLOOR(@nNum)
                    SET @sTdec_num = @nNum - @sFloor_num
                    SET @sDec_num = @nNum - @sFloor_num

                    IF CAST(@sDec_num as NUMERIC(38,12)) > 0 
                        BEGIN
                            SET @sDec_num = dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING(@sDec_num, 0)
                            SET @sTemp = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@sDec_num)
                            SET @sDec_num = SUBSTRING(@sTemp,3,LEN(@sTemp)-1)          
                        END
                    ELSE --then value is zero
                        SET @sDec_num = replicate( @sAfterdecchar, @nDec_place)
                END

            IF @sGrp_sepr = ' '
                SET @sGrp_sepr = REPLACE(@sGrp_sepr, ' ', '~')

            IF LEN(@sFloor_num) > @nGrp_digit and @nGrp_digit > 0 
                BEGIN
                    SET @nFloorcnt = FLOOR(LEN(@sFloor_num)/@nGrp_digit)
                    WHILE @nFloorcnt > 0
                        BEGIN
                            SET @ni = @ni + 1
                            IF @sFmt_floor IS NULL OR @sFmt_floor = '' 
                                SET @sFmt_floor = SUBSTRING(@sFloor_num, 1, (LEN(@sFloor_num) - @nGrp_digit)) + @sGrp_sepr + RIGHT(@sFloor_num, @nGrp_digit)
                            ELSE
                                                                SET @sFmt_floor = SUBSTRING(@sFmt_floor, 1, (LEN(@sFmt_floor) - (@nGrp_digit*@ni) - (LEN(@sGrp_sepr)*(@ni-1)))) + @sGrp_sepr + RIGHT(@sFmt_floor, ((@nGrp_digit*@ni)+(LEN(@sGrp_sepr)*(@ni-1))))
                            
                                                        SET @nFloorcnt = @nFloorcnt - 1
                        END
                END
            ELSE
                SET @sFmt_floor = @sFloor_num

            IF @nDec_place = 0 
                SET @sFmt_num = REVERSE(dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING(REVERSE(@sFmt_floor), @sGrp_sepr))
            ELSE        
                SET @sFmt_num = REVERSE(dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING(REVERSE(@sFmt_floor), @sGrp_sepr)) + @sDec_sepr + @sDec_num

            IF @nSignVal = -1 
                SET @sFmt_num = @sNeg_sym + @sFmt_num

        END

   ELSE
        SET @sFmt_num = @nNumtofmt

   IF @nDec_place > 0 
        SET @sFmt_num = REPLACE(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(REPLACE(@sFmt_num,'0',' ')),' ','0'),@sDec_sepr,' ')),' ',@sDec_sepr)

   SET @sFmt_num = REPLACE(@sFmt_num, '~', ' ')

   RETURN @sFmt_num
END

create function [dbo].[R5REP_REPFMTNUM2LOCALE](@usr NVARCHAR(255), @sOrg nvarchar(30), @nNumtofmt NVARCHAR(100))

begin

        FROM R5LOCALE
        WHERE LOC_CODE = (coalesce((select usr_locale from r5users where usr_code = @usr),
					(select org_locale from r5organization where org_code = @sOrg),
					(select ins_desc from r5install where ins_code='LOCALE')))

        SET @sFmt_num = @nNumtofmt

        IF isnumeric(@nNumtofmt) = 1
        BEGIN
            SET @nNumtoformat = @nNumtofmt
            SET @ni = 0
            SET @sAfterdecchar = N'0'
            SET @nSignVal = SIGN(@nNumtoformat)
            SET @nNum = @nNumtoformat

            IF @nSignVal = -1
                SET @nNum = -1 * @nNumtoformat

            IF @nDec_place = 0 
                SET @sFloor_num = ROUND(@nNum,0)
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SET @sFloor_num = FLOOR(@nNum)
                    SET @sTdec_num = @nNum - @sFloor_num
                    SET @sDec_num = @nNum - @sFloor_num

                    IF CAST(@sDec_num as NUMERIC(38,12)) > 0 
                        BEGIN
                            SET @sDec_num = dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING(@sDec_num, 0)
                            SET @sTemp = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@sDec_num)
                            SET @sDec_num = SUBSTRING(@sTemp,3,LEN(@sTemp)-1)          
                        END
                    ELSE --then value is zero
                        SET @sDec_num = replicate( @sAfterdecchar, @nDec_place)
                END

            IF @sGrp_sepr = ' '
                SET @sGrp_sepr = REPLACE(@sGrp_sepr, ' ', '~')

            IF LEN(@sFloor_num) > @nGrp_digit and @nGrp_digit > 0 
                BEGIN
                    SET @nFloorcnt = FLOOR(LEN(@sFloor_num)/@nGrp_digit)
                    WHILE @nFloorcnt > 0
                        BEGIN
                            SET @ni = @ni + 1
                            IF @sFmt_floor IS NULL OR @sFmt_floor = '' 
                                SET @sFmt_floor = SUBSTRING(@sFloor_num, 1, (LEN(@sFloor_num) - @nGrp_digit)) + @sGrp_sepr + RIGHT(@sFloor_num, @nGrp_digit)
                            ELSE
                                                                SET @sFmt_floor = SUBSTRING(@sFmt_floor, 1, (LEN(@sFmt_floor) - (@nGrp_digit*@ni) - (LEN(@sGrp_sepr)*(@ni-1)))) + @sGrp_sepr + RIGHT(@sFmt_floor, ((@nGrp_digit*@ni)+(LEN(@sGrp_sepr)*(@ni-1))))
                            
                                                        SET @nFloorcnt = @nFloorcnt - 1
                        END
                END
            ELSE
                SET @sFmt_floor = @sFloor_num

            IF @nDec_place = 0 
                SET @sFmt_num = REVERSE(dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING(REVERSE(@sFmt_floor), @sGrp_sepr))
            ELSE        
                SET @sFmt_num = REVERSE(dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING(REVERSE(@sFmt_floor), @sGrp_sepr)) + @sDec_sepr + @sDec_num

            IF @nSignVal = -1 
                SET @sFmt_num = @sNeg_sym + @sFmt_num

        END

   ELSE
        SET @sFmt_num = @nNumtofmt

   IF @nDec_place > 0 
        SET @sFmt_num = REPLACE(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(REPLACE(@sFmt_num,'0',' ')),' ','0'),@sDec_sepr,' ')),' ',@sDec_sepr)

   SET @sFmt_num = REPLACE(@sFmt_num, '~', ' ')

   RETURN @sFmt_num
END

create function [dbo].[R5REP_REPFMTNUM2LOCALE](@usr NVARCHAR(255), @sOrg nvarchar(30), @nNumtofmt NVARCHAR(100))
returns nvarchar(100)
as
begin
    Declare @sTdec_num       NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @sFloor_num      NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @sDec_num        NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @sFmt_floor      NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @sFmt_num        NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @nFloorcnt       INTEGER
    Declare @nSignVal        INTEGER
    Declare @nNum            NUMERIC(38,12)
    Declare @sAfterdecchar   NVARCHAR(1)
    Declare @nDec_place      INTEGER
    Declare @sDec_sepr       NVARCHAR(3)
    Declare @sGrp_sepr       NVARCHAR(1)
    Declare @nGrp_digit      INTEGER
    Declare @sNeg_sym        NVARCHAR(1)
    Declare @sTemp           NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @nNumtoformat    NUMERIC(38,12)
    Declare @ni              INTEGER

        SELECT @nDec_place=coalesce(LOC_FRACTDIGITS,0), @sDec_sepr=LOC_DECSYM, @sGrp_sepr=LOC_GRPSYM, 
                  @nGrp_digit=coalesce(LOC_GRPDIGITS,0), @sNeg_sym=coalesce(LOC_NEGSYM,'-')
        FROM R5LOCALE
        WHERE LOC_CODE = (coalesce((select usr_locale from r5users where usr_code = @usr),
					(select org_locale from r5organization where org_code = @sOrg),
					(select ins_desc from r5install where ins_code='LOCALE')))

        SET @sFmt_num = @nNumtofmt

        IF isnumeric(@nNumtofmt) = 1
        BEGIN
            SET @nNumtoformat = @nNumtofmt
            SET @ni = 0
            SET @sAfterdecchar = N'0'
            SET @nSignVal = SIGN(@nNumtoformat)
            SET @nNum = @nNumtoformat

            IF @nSignVal = -1
                SET @nNum = -1 * @nNumtoformat

            IF @nDec_place = 0 
                SET @sFloor_num = ROUND(@nNum,0)
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SET @sFloor_num = FLOOR(@nNum)
                    SET @sTdec_num = @nNum - @sFloor_num
                    SET @sDec_num = @nNum - @sFloor_num

                    IF CAST(@sDec_num as NUMERIC(38,12)) > 0 
                        BEGIN
                            SET @sDec_num = dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING(@sDec_num, 0)
                            SET @sTemp = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@sDec_num)
                            SET @sDec_num = SUBSTRING(@sTemp,3,LEN(@sTemp)-1)          
                        END
                    ELSE --then value is zero
                        SET @sDec_num = replicate( @sAfterdecchar, @nDec_place)
                END

            IF @sGrp_sepr = ' '
                SET @sGrp_sepr = REPLACE(@sGrp_sepr, ' ', '~')

            IF LEN(@sFloor_num) > @nGrp_digit and @nGrp_digit > 0 
                BEGIN
                    SET @nFloorcnt = FLOOR(LEN(@sFloor_num)/@nGrp_digit)
                    WHILE @nFloorcnt > 0
                        BEGIN
                            SET @ni = @ni + 1
                            IF @sFmt_floor IS NULL OR @sFmt_floor = '' 
                                SET @sFmt_floor = SUBSTRING(@sFloor_num, 1, (LEN(@sFloor_num) - @nGrp_digit)) + @sGrp_sepr + RIGHT(@sFloor_num, @nGrp_digit)
                            ELSE
                                                                SET @sFmt_floor = SUBSTRING(@sFmt_floor, 1, (LEN(@sFmt_floor) - (@nGrp_digit*@ni) - (LEN(@sGrp_sepr)*(@ni-1)))) + @sGrp_sepr + RIGHT(@sFmt_floor, ((@nGrp_digit*@ni)+(LEN(@sGrp_sepr)*(@ni-1))))
                            
                                                        SET @nFloorcnt = @nFloorcnt - 1
                        END
                END
            ELSE
                SET @sFmt_floor = @sFloor_num

            IF @nDec_place = 0 
                SET @sFmt_num = REVERSE(dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING(REVERSE(@sFmt_floor), @sGrp_sepr))
            ELSE        
                SET @sFmt_num = REVERSE(dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING(REVERSE(@sFmt_floor), @sGrp_sepr)) + @sDec_sepr + @sDec_num

            IF @nSignVal = -1 
                SET @sFmt_num = @sNeg_sym + @sFmt_num

        END

   ELSE
        SET @sFmt_num = @nNumtofmt

   IF @nDec_place > 0 
        SET @sFmt_num = REPLACE(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(RTRIM(REPLACE(@sFmt_num,'0',' ')),' ','0'),@sDec_sepr,' ')),' ',@sDec_sepr)

   SET @sFmt_num = REPLACE(@sFmt_num, '~', ' ')

   RETURN @sFmt_num
END

name: R5REP_REPSTRUCTSYSTEMS
body:
CREATE FUNCTION R5REP_REPSTRUCTSYSTEMS (@sDeforg    nvarchar(15),
                                        @sObjcode   nvarchar(30),
                                        @sObjorg    nvarchar(15))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000)
AS 
BEGIN
	declare @nLevel     int
	declare @sString    nvarchar(200)
    declare @sCode      nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOrg       nvarchar(15)
    declare @sType      nvarchar(4)
    declare @bFirst     bit
    declare @sReturn    nvarchar(4000)
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_parent		nvarchar(30), 
							stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15), 
                            stc_parentrtype nvarchar(4),
							LevelID int )

    declare @tTemp table ( sTemp nvarchar(200) )

	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_parent, 
				stc_parent_org,
                stc_parentrtype,
				1 
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_child		= @sObjcode	and 
				stc_child_org	= @sObjorg 

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sString    = CASE stc_parent_org WHEN @sDeforg THEN stc_parent ELSE stc_parent + N' (' + stc_parent_org + N')' END,
                            @sCode      = stc_parent,
                            @sOrg       = stc_parent_org,
                            @sType      = stc_parentrtype
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel

                    if @sType = N'S'
    					insert into @tTemp values ( @sString )

					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_parent = @sCode and stc_parent_org = @sOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_parent, 
												stc_parent_org,
                                                stc_parentrtype,
												@nLevel + 1
											from	r5structures
											where	stc_child      = @sCode and
													stc_child_org  = @sOrg	
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

    set @bFirst = 1
    declare c_temp cursor local for select sTemp from @tTemp order by sTemp
    open c_temp
    fetch next from c_temp into @sString
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            if @bFirst = 1
                begin
                    set @sReturn = @sString
                    set @bFirst = 0
                end
            else
                set @sReturn = @sReturn + N' / ' + @sString
        
            fetch next from c_temp into @sString
        end
    close c_temp
    deallocate c_temp

	return @sReturn
END

CREATE VIEW R5REQSFORJOB
     ( rfj_req,

       rfj_store,
       rfj_part,
       rfj_part_org,

	SELECT r.rql_req,

create function R5RETURNONEVENT ( @sEvent    nvarchar(30) )
returns float
as
	begin
		declare @nResult		float

		SELECT @nResult = SUM( coalesce( l.trl_price, 0 ) * coalesce( l.trl_qty, 0 ) )
		FROM   r5translines    l,
			 r5transactions  t
		WHERE  l.trl_trans       = t.tra_code
		AND    t.tra_fromrentity = N'EVNT'
		AND    t.tra_fromcode    = @sEvent
		AND    t.tra_torentity   = N'COMP'
		AND    l.trl_rtype       = N'RETN'
  
		set @nResult = coalesce (@nResult, 0)

		return (@nResult)
	end

name: R5TRANSACTIONS
body:
ALTER TABLE R5TRANSACTIONS DISABLE TRIGGER PREUPD_TRA' )

                                UPDATE r5transactions
                                   SET tra_rstatus = N'U'
                                 WHERE tra_code = @sTranscode

                                exec( N'ALTER TABLE R5TRANSACTIONS ENABLE TRIGGER PREUPD_TRA' )
                            end try 
                            begin catch
                                declare @sErrorMessage  nvarchar(4000)
                                declare @nErrorSeverity int
                                declare @nErrorState    int
                
                                select @sErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
                                       @nErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
                                       @nErrorState = ERROR_STATE()
                
                                close c_trl
                                deallocate c_trl
                                exec( N'ALTER TABLE R5TRANSACTIONS ENABLE TRIGGER PREUPD_TRA' )
                
                                RAISERROR(@sErrorMessage, @nErrorSeverity, @nErrorState)
                            end catch
                        end

                    DELETE FROM r5translines
                     WHERE trl_trans = @sTranscode

                    DELETE FROM r5transactions
                     WHERE tra_code = @sTranscode

                    fetch next from c_trl into @sTranscode, @sTransstatus
                end
            close c_trl
            deallocate c_trl

            UPDATE r5binstock 
               SET bis_qty = 0 
             WHERE bis_part = @sPart
               AND bis_part_org = @sPartOrg
               AND bis_store = @sStore
               AND bis_bin = @sBin
               AND bis_lot = @sLot
        end

CREATE VIEW R5VBOOKEDHOURS
(VBO_BILL, VBO_COSTCODE, VBO_OBJECT, VBO_OBJECT_ORG, VBO_ADJUSTMENT, 
 VBO_BILLSUBLINE, VBO_FLEETCHECKED, VBO_EVENT, VBO_JOBTYPE, VBO_ACT, 
 VBO_PERSON, VBO_TRADE, VBO_MRC, VBO_HOURS, VBO_RATE, 
 VBO_COST, VBO_MARKUP, VBO_DATE, VBO_MAINTENANCE, VBO_INTERNAL,VBO_ACTPARENT,VBO_TASK,VBO_JOBSEQ,VBO_JOBPLAN,VBO_JOBREUSABLE)
AS 
SELECT fbs_bill,
       fbs_costcode,
       fbs_object,
       fbs_object_org,
       fbs_adjustment,
       boo_billsubline,
       boo_fleetchecked,
       boo_event,
       evt_jobtype,
       boo_act,
       boo_person,
       boo_trade,
       boo_mrc,
       boo_hours,
       boo_rate,

       act_task,
       act_seq,
       tsk_jobplan,

AND    evt_code = boo_event

       tfs_adjustment,
       tbo_tempsubline,
       tbo_fleetchecked,
       boo_event,
       evt_jobtype,
       boo_act,
       boo_person,

       boo_cost,
	   tbo_fleetmarkup,

       CASE tbo_fleetchecked WHEN N'M' THEN N'+' WHEN N'C' THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END,

 VBS_FUELMARKUP, VBS_MILES, VBS_MILEAGERATE, VBS_MILEAGECHARGE, VBS_MILEAGEMARKUP,

 VBS_PARTSMNT, VBS_PARTSMNTMARKUP, VBS_CONTRLABORMNT, VBS_CONTRLABORMNTMARKUP, VBS_EXCEPTIONS, 
 VBS_TOTAL, VBS_ADJPK, VBS_TICKETTYPE, VBS_TICKETISSUEDTO, VBS_TICKETISSUEDATE, 
 VBS_TICKETRETURNDATE, VBS_ADJCREATEDBY, VBS_ADJDATE, VBS_ADJEXCEPTION)
AS 
SELECT fbs_pk,
       fbs_bill,
       fbs_costcode,
       fbs_object,
       fbs_object_org,
       fbs_adjustment,
       fbs_ticket,
       fbs_daysbilled,
       fbs_hours,
       fbs_billingcode,
       fbs_billingcode_org,
       fbs_markupcode,
       fbs_markupcode_org,
       fbs_reading,
       fbs_fuel,
       fbs_fuelmarkup,
       fbs_miles,
       CASE fbs_miles WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( fbs_mileage / fbs_miles,2 ) END,
       fbs_mileage,
       fbs_mileagemarkup,
       coalesce( fbs_mileage, 0 ) + coalesce( fbs_mileagemarkup, 0 ),
       CASE fti_rtype WHEN  N'A' THEN fbs_daysbilled ELSE fbs_hours END,
       CASE CASE fti_rtype WHEN N'A' THEN fbs_daysbilled ELSE fbs_hours END WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( fbs_usage / CASE fti_rtype WHEN N'A' THEN fbs_daysbilled ELSE fbs_hours END, 2 ) END,
       fbs_usage,
       fbs_usagemarkup,
       coalesce( fbs_usage, 0 ) + coalesce( fbs_usagemarkup, 0 ),
       CASE CASE fti_rtype WHEN N'A' THEN fbs_daysbilled ELSE fbs_hours END WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( fbs_insurance / CASE fti_rtype WHEN N'A' THEN fbs_daysbilled ELSE fbs_hours END, 2 ) END,
       fbs_insurance,
       fbs_insurancemarkup,
       coalesce( fbs_insurance, 0 ) + coalesce( fbs_insurancemarkup, 0 ),
       fbs_repair,
       fbs_laborrep,
       fbs_laborrepmarkup,
       fbs_partsrep,
       fbs_partsrepmarkup,
       fbs_contrlaborrep,
       fbs_contrlaborrepmarkup,
       fbs_maintenance,
       fbs_labormnt,
       fbs_labormntmarkup,
       fbs_partsmnt,
       fbs_partsmntmarkup,
       fbs_contrlabormnt,

       fbs_exceptions,
       fbs_total,
       fbs_adjpk,
       fti_type,
       fti_person,
       fti_issuedate,
       fti_returndate,
       fba_createdby,
       fba_date,
       fba_exception
FROM   r5fleetbillsublines left outer join r5fleettickets on (fbs_ticket = fti_code)
							left outer join r5billingadjustments on (fbs_adjpk  = fba_pk) 
UNION ALL
SELECT tfs_pk,
       tfs_session,
       tfs_costcode,
       tfs_object,
       tfs_object_org,
       tfs_adjustment,
       tfs_ticket,
       tfs_daysbilled,
       tfs_hours,
       tfs_billingcode,
       tfs_billingcode_org,
       tfs_markupcode,
       tfs_markupcode_org,
       tfs_reading,
       tfs_fuel,
       tfs_fuelmarkup,
       tfs_miles,
       CASE tfs_miles WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( tfs_mileage / tfs_miles,2 ) END,
       tfs_mileage,
       tfs_mileagemarkup,
       coalesce( tfs_mileage, 0 ) + coalesce( tfs_mileagemarkup, 0 ),

CREATE VIEW R5WORKORDERPARTSUMMARY
(TRL_EVENT, TRL_ACT, TRL_PART, TRL_PART_ORG, TRL_STORE, 
 TRL_LINE, TRL_DIRECT, TRL_MATLIST, TRL_MATLISTREV,
 TRL_MANUFACTURER, TRL_MANUFACTPART)
AS 
SELECT
   l.trl_event,
   l.trl_act,
   l.trl_part,
   l.trl_part_org,
   l.trl_store,
   0 line,
   case when l.trl_rtype = 'RECV' then '+'
        when l.trl_rtype = 'RR' then '-'
        when l.trl_rtype = 'I' then (case when l.trl_io = 0 then '+' else '-' end)
   end direct,
   null matlist,
   null matlistrev,
   trl_manufacturer, 
   trl_manufactpart
FROM   r5transactions t,
       r5translines l,
       r5events e
WHERE  l.trl_trans       = t.tra_code
AND    t.tra_torentity   = N'EVNT'
AND    t.tra_fromrentity = CASE l.trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN N'COMP' ELSE t.tra_fromrentity END
AND    l.trl_rtype IN ( N'I', N'RR', N'RECV' )
AND    e.evt_code = l.trl_event
AND    e.evt_routeparent IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT r.res_event,
   r.res_act,
   r.res_part,
   r.res_part_org,
   r.res_store,
   0 line,
   '-' direct,
   null matlist,
   null matlistrev,
   null trl_manufacturer,
   null trl_manufactpart
FROM   r5reservations r
UNION
SELECT
   a.act_event,
   a.act_act,
   m.mlp_part,
   m.mlp_part_org,
   CASE isnull(str_org,e.evt_org) WHEN e.evt_org THEN d.mrc_store ELSE null END,
   m.mlp_line line,
   m.mlp_direct direct,
   m.mlp_matlist matlist,
   m.mlp_matlrev matlistrev,
   null trl_manufacturer,
   null trl_manufactpart
FROM   r5matlparts m,
       r5objects o LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events e1 ON ( o.obj_code = e1.evt_object AND o.obj_org  = e1.evt_object_org ),
       r5events e,
       r5activities a,
	   r5stores s RIGHT OUTER JOIN
       r5mrcs d ON ( d.mrc_store   = s.str_code )
WHERE  a.act_matlist = m.mlp_matlist
AND    a.act_matlrev = m.mlp_matlrev
AND    a.act_event   = e.evt_code
AND    e.evt_mrc     = d.mrc_code
AND    dbo.o7checkmatch( mlp_equipfilter, obj_checklistfilter ) = '+'
AND ( ( isnull(m.mlp_code, isnull(e.evt_object,N'!@#$%')) = isnull(e.evt_object,N'!@#$%')
AND isnull(m.mlp_code_org, isnull(e.evt_object_org,N'!@#$%')) = isnull(e.evt_object_org,N'!@#$%'))
 OR ( m.mlp_obrtype = N'C'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT obj_code
	              FROM r5objects
				  WHERE obj_code = e.evt_object
				  AND   obj_org = e.evt_object_org
				  AND   obj_category = m.mlp_code) ) )

create function REPACTDMA (	@sSource      nvarchar(8),
                    @sCode        nvarchar(30),
                    @sClass       nvarchar(80),
                    @dDatefrom    datetime,
                    @dDateto      datetime,
                    @sWarranty    nvarchar(30))
returns numeric(30,6)
as
begin
  declare @nCost    numeric(30,6)
  declare @nDMA     numeric(5,2)

	set @nCost = 0.0
    SELECT  @nDMA = coalesce(doc_dmacharge, 100 ) 
    FROM    r5documents
    WHERE   doc_code =  @sWarranty
    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
        set @nDMA = 100

  SET @nCost = COALESCE(  dbo.o7repgetwocostperiod( @sCode, NULL, NULL, 'DM', CONVERT( NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom, 120 ), CONVERT( NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto, 120 ), NULL ), 0.0 )

	return isnull( @nCost, 0 ) * @nDMA / 100
end

create function REPACTFIX (	@sSource      nvarchar(8),
                    @sCode        nvarchar(30),

                    @sWarranty    nvarchar(30))
returns numeric(30,6)
as
begin
  declare @nCost    numeric(30,6)

	set @nCost = 0.0
    SELECT  @nFix = coalesce(doc_toolcharge, 100 ) 
    FROM    r5documents
    WHERE   doc_code =  @sWarranty
    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
        set @nFix = 100

  SET @nCost = COALESCE(  dbo.o7repgetwocostperiod( @sCode, NULL, NULL, 'FL', CONVERT( NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom, 120 ), CONVERT( NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto, 120 ), NULL ), 0.0 )

create function REPCOMMENTS(	@sCode	nvarchar(100), 
											@sOrg	nvarchar(15),
											@sEnt	nvarchar(4),
                                            @sLine    nvarchar(8) )
returns nvarchar(4000)
as
begin  

    declare @sComm      nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sTempCode  nvarchar(100)
    declare @sCR        nvarchar(80)
    declare @sText      nvarchar(4000)
    declare @nLine      numeric(8)

    IF  @sEnt IN (N'PORD', N'CLAS', N'PART', N'INV' , N'COMP', N'OBJ',  N'EIV',  N'RMA', N'PORL', N'EIL' ) 
        set @sTempCode = @sCode + N'#' +  @sOrg
    ELSE
        set @sTempCode = @sCode

    IF @sLine IS NOT NULL 
        set @sTempCode = @sTempCode + N'#' + @sLine 

	set @sCR = '' 
    set @sComm = ''

    declare c_comm cursor local for	SELECT substring(add_text,1,4000), add_line
                                        FROM r5addetails
                                        WHERE add_code = @sCode
                                        AND   add_entity = @sEnt
                                        ORDER BY add_line

	open c_comm
	fetch next from c_comm into	@sText, @nLine
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			--Add 16 characters to the check of 
            
             set @sText = dbo.o7trimtags(@sText)
            if (len(@sComm) + len(@sText) + len(cast(@nLine as nvarchar(8))) + 8) >= 4000
                begin
                    set @sComm = coalesce(@sComm, '') + N'Line ' +  cast(@nLine as nvarchar(8)) + @sCR + (left(@sText, 4000 - (len(@sComm) + len(cast(@nLine as nvarchar(8))) + 8 ))) + @sCR + @sCR 
                    break
                end
            else
                set @sComm = coalesce(@sComm, '') + N'Line ' +  cast(@nLine as nvarchar(8)) + @sCR + @sText + @sCR + @sCR 
                
            fetch next from c_comm into	@sText, @nLine
		end
	close c_comm
	deallocate c_comm


    return @sComm

end

create function REPCUSTOMATTRIB(	@sCode	nvarchar(30),
					@sOrg	nvarchar(15),
					@sAttrib	nvarchar(15),
                                        @sEntity    nvarchar(15),
					@sR5user    nvarchar(255))
returns nvarchar(40)
as
begin

    declare @sRetvalue      nvarchar(40)
    declare @sPrvCode       nvarchar(100)
    declare @sType          nvarchar(4)
    declare @sMulti         nvarchar(1)
    declare @sCategories    nvarchar(30)

    SELECT @sType = pro_type
    FROM   r5properties
    WHERE  pro_code    = @sAttrib

    IF  @sEntity IN (N'PORD', N'CLAS', N'PART', N'INV' , N'COMP', N'OBJ',  N'EIV',  N'RMA', N'PORL', N'EIL' ) 
        set @sPrvCode = @sCode + N'#' +  @sOrg
    ELSE
        set @sPrvCode = @sCode


	SELECT @sRetvalue = CASE @sType WHEN N'NUM' THEN convert( nvarchar, prv_nvalue )
									WHEN N'DATE' THEN dbo.REPGETFMTDATE( @sR5user, prv_dvalue)
									WHEN N'DATI' THEN dbo.REPGETFMTDATI( @sR5user, prv_dvalue)
									ELSE prv_value
									END
	FROM r5propertyvalues
	WHERE prv_property   = @sAttrib
	AND   prv_code       = @sPrvCode
	AND   prv_rentity    = @sEntity

    IF @sRetvalue IS NULL AND @sEntity = 'OBJ' 
        begin
            SELECT @sCategories = case obj_obrtype when N'C' then obj_code else obj_category end
            FROM   r5objects
            WHERE  obj_code = @sCode
            AND    obj_org  = @sOrg

            IF @sCategories IS NOT NULL 
	            SELECT @sRetvalue = CASE @sType WHEN N'NUM' THEN convert( nvarchar, prv_nvalue )
									            WHEN N'DATE' THEN cast( prv_dvalue as nvarchar(40) )
									            WHEN N'DATI' THEN cast( prv_dvalue as nvarchar(40) )
									            ELSE prv_value
									            END
	            FROM r5propertyvalues
	            WHERE prv_property   = @sAttrib
	            AND   prv_code       = @sCategories
	            AND   prv_rentity    = @sEntity

	  end

	  RETURN( @sRetvalue )

end

CREATE FUNCTION REPEVTSYSTEMS (@deforg VARCHAR(30),
								   @evtcode VARCHAR(30))
RETURNS VARCHAR(1000) AS

BEGIN
	DECLARE @rec INT
	DECLARE @syscode VARCHAR(50)
	DECLARE @sysorg VARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @sysstr VARCHAR(1000)

	DECLARE c_esy CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT CASE esy_system_org when @deforg then esy_system else esy_system + N' (' + esy_system_org + N')' end 
                                        FROM    r5evtsystems
                                        WHERE   esy_event = @evtcode
                                        ORDER BY    1

	OPEN c_esy
	FETCH NEXT FROM c_esy INTO @syscode

	SET @rec  = 0
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @rec = @rec + 1
		IF @rec = 1 
			SET @sysstr = @syscode
		ELSE
			SET @sysstr = @sysstr + ' / ' + @syscode

		FETCH NEXT FROM c_esy INTO @syscode
	END
	CLOSE c_esy
	DEALLOCATE c_esy

	RETURN @sysstr
END

create function REPEXCH (   @sEvent         nvarchar(30),
                            @sReportingcurr nvarchar(3),
                            @sActualcurrent nvarchar(1)  )
returns float
as
begin
  declare @nVExch     numeric(24,12)
  declare @sBaseorg   nvarchar(15)    --r5organization.org_code%Type
  declare @sBasecurr  nvarchar(3)     --r5organization.org_curr%Type
  declare @sRepcurr   nvarchar(3)     --r5organization.org_curr%Type
  declare @dExchdate  datetime

  if @sReportingcurr is null
      begin
          set @nVExch = 1
          set @sRepcurr = dbo.o7dflt2( N'DEFCURR')
      end
  else
      begin
          set @nVExch = 1
          set @sRepcurr = @sReportingcurr
      end

  if Upper( @sActualcurrent ) = N'-'
      begin
          select @sBasecurr = o.org_curr, 
                  @dExchdate = isnull( e.evt_completed, e.evt_date), 
                  @sBaseorg = e.evt_org
          from   r5organization o,
                 r5events       e
          where  e.evt_org  = o.org_code
          and    e.evt_code = @sEvent
          if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
              begin
                  set @sBasecurr = null
                  set @dExchdate = null
              end
      end
  else
      begin
          select @sBasecurr = o.org_curr, 
                  @dExchdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( e.evt_org), N'DD' ), 
                  @sBaseorg = e.evt_org
          from   r5organization o,
                 r5events       e
          where  e.evt_org  = o.org_code
          and    e.evt_code = @sEvent
          if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
              begin
                  set @sBasecurr = null
                  set @dExchdate = null
              end
      end

  IF @sRepcurr = @sBasecurr
      SET @nVExch = 1
  ELSE
      SET @nVExch = dbo.o7gtexch2( @sRepcurr, @sBaseorg, @dExchdate ) 

  return isnull( @nVExch, 1) 
end

body:
create function DBO.REPFMTCALIBRATION(@usr NVARCHAR(255), @numtofmt NVARCHAR(100), @precision INTEGER)
returns nvarchar(100)
as
begin
    Declare @tdec_num       NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @tnum			NUMERIC(38,12)

    Declare @floor_num      NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @dec_num        NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @fmt_floor      NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @fmt_num        NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @floorcnt       INTEGER
    Declare @signVal		INTEGER
    Declare @num			NUMERIC(38,12)
    Declare @afterdecchar   NVARCHAR(1)
    Declare @dec_place      INTEGER
    Declare @dec_sepr       NVARCHAR(3)
    Declare @grp_sepr       NVARCHAR(1)
    Declare @grp_digit      INTEGER
    Declare @neg_sym		NVARCHAR(1)
    Declare @temp           NVARCHAR(100)
    Declare @numtoformat    NUMERIC(38,12)
    Declare @ni		        INTEGER

	SELECT  @dec_sepr=LOC_DECSYM, @grp_sepr=LOC_GRPSYM, 
		  @grp_digit=coalesce(LOC_GRPDIGITS,0), @neg_sym=coalesce(LOC_NEGSYM,'-')
	FROM R5LOCALE
	WHERE LOC_CODE = (Select coalesce(USR_LOCALE,'NAMERICA') FROM R5USERS WHERE USR_CODE = @usr)

	SET @dec_place = @precision
	SET @fmt_num = @numtofmt

	IF isnumeric(@numtofmt) = 1
        BEGIN
            SET @numtoformat = @numtofmt
            SET @ni = 0
            SET @afterdecchar = N'0'
            SET @signVal = SIGN(@numtoformat)
            SET @num = ROUND(@numtoformat,@dec_place)

            IF @signVal = -1
                SET @num = ROUND(-@numtoformat,@dec_place)

            IF @dec_place = 0 
                SET @floor_num = ROUND(@num,0)
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SET @floor_num = FLOOR(@num)
                    SET @tdec_num = @num - @floor_num
                    SET @dec_num = @num - @floor_num

                    IF CAST(@dec_num as NUMERIC(38,12)) > 0 
                        BEGIN
                            SET @dec_num = dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING(@dec_num, 0)
                            SET @temp = dbo.F_RPAD(@dec_num, @dec_place+2, @afterdecchar)
                            SET @dec_num = SUBSTRING(@temp,3,LEN(@temp)-1)	  
                        END
                    ELSE --then value is zero
                        SET @dec_num = replicate( @afterdecchar, @dec_place)
                END

            IF @grp_sepr = ' '
                SET @grp_sepr = REPLACE(@grp_sepr, ' ', '~')

            IF LEN(@floor_num) > @grp_digit and @grp_digit > 0 
                BEGIN
                    SET @floorcnt = FLOOR(LEN(@floor_num)/@grp_digit)
                    WHILE @floorcnt > 0
                        BEGIN
                            SET @ni = @ni + 1
                            IF @fmt_floor IS NULL OR @fmt_floor = '' 
                                SET @fmt_floor = SUBSTRING(@floor_num, 1, (LEN(@floor_num) - @grp_digit)) + @grp_sepr + RIGHT(@floor_num, @grp_digit)
                            ELSE
								SET @fmt_floor = SUBSTRING(@fmt_floor, 1, (LEN(@fmt_floor) - (@grp_digit*@ni) - (LEN(@grp_sepr)*(@ni-1)))) + @grp_sepr + RIGHT(@fmt_floor, ((@grp_digit*@ni)+(LEN(@grp_sepr)*(@ni-1))))
                            
							SET @floorcnt = @floorcnt - 1
                        END
                END
            ELSE
                SET @fmt_floor = @floor_num

            IF @dec_place = 0 
                SET @fmt_num = REVERSE(dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING(REVERSE(@fmt_floor), @grp_sepr))
            ELSE	
                SET @fmt_num = REVERSE(dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING(REVERSE(@fmt_floor), @grp_sepr)) + @dec_sepr + @dec_num

            IF @signVal = -1 
                SET @fmt_num = @neg_sym + @fmt_num

        END

   ELSE
        SET @fmt_num = @numtofmt

  
   SET @fmt_num = REPLACE(@fmt_num, '~', ' ')

   RETURN @fmt_num
END
0

CREATE FUNCTION REPGCD ( 
  @dividend INTEGER, 
  @divisor INTEGER )
RETURNS INTEGER AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @remainder INTEGER = -1
  IF @divisor = 0 RETURN @dividend
  WHILE @remainder != 0
  BEGIN
    SET @remainder = @dividend % @divisor
    SET @dividend = @divisor
    SET @divisor = @remainder
  END
  RETURN @dividend
END

CREATE function REPGETADDTEXT ( @sRentity nvarchar(4),
                                @sLang nvarchar(2),
                                @sCode nvarchar(100))
RETURNS nvarchar(4000)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sText	nvarchar(4000)
    DECLARE @sComm      nvarchar(4000)

        SET @sText = ''
        SET @sComm = ''

    DECLARE c_comm CURSOR LOCAL FOR     SELECT SUBSTRING(add_text,1,4000) 
                                        FROM r5addetails
                                        WHERE add_code   = @sCode
                                        AND   add_rentity = @sRentity 
                                        AND   add_lang   = @sLang
                                        AND   add_print  = N'+'
                                        ORDER BY add_line

    OPEN c_comm
    FETCH NEXT FROM c_comm INTO  @sText 
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
          BEGIN
            
               set @sText = dbo.o7trimtags(@sText)
            SET @sComm = SUBSTRING(@sComm + N' ' + @sText,1,4000) 
            FETCH NEXT FROM c_comm INTO  @sText
          END
    CLOSE c_comm
    DEALLOCATE c_comm
    RETURN @sComm

END
