create function REPGETCOMMENTS(	@sCode	nvarchar(100), 
								@sOrg	nvarchar(15),
								@sEnt	nvarchar(4),
                                @sLine  nvarchar(8),
                                @sLang	nvarchar(2))
returns nvarchar(4000)
as
begin  

    declare @sComm      nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sTempCode  nvarchar(100)
    declare @sCR        nvarchar(80)
    declare @sText      nvarchar(4000)
    declare @nLine      numeric(8)

    IF  @sEnt IN (N'PORD', N'CLAS', N'PART', N'INV' , N'COMP', N'OBJ',  N'EIV',  N'RMA', N'PORL', N'EIL' ) 
        set @sTempCode = @sCode + N'#' +  @sOrg
    ELSE
        set @sTempCode = @sCode

    IF @sLine IS NOT NULL 
        set @sTempCode = @sTempCode + N'#' + @sLine 

	set @sCR = '' 
    set @sComm = ''

    declare c_comm cursor local for	SELECT substring(add_text,1,4000), add_line
                                        FROM r5addetails
                                        WHERE add_code = @sCode
                                        AND   add_rentity = @sEnt 
                                        AND   add_lang = @sLang
                                        ORDER BY add_line

	open c_comm
	fetch next from c_comm into	@sText, @nLine
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			--Add 16 characters to the check of 
            
               set @sText = dbo.o7trimtags(@sText)

            if (len(@sComm) + len(@sText) + len(cast(@nLine as nvarchar(8))) + 8) >= 4000
                begin
                    set @sComm = coalesce(@sComm, ' ') + N'Line ' +  cast(@nLine as nvarchar(8)) + @sCR + (left(@sText, 4000 - (len(@sComm) + len(cast(@nLine as nvarchar(8))) + 8 ))) + @sCR + @sCR 
                    break
                end
            else
                set @sComm = coalesce(@sComm, ' ') + N'Line ' +  cast(@nLine as nvarchar(8)) + @sCR + @sText + @sCR + @sCR 
                
            fetch next from c_comm into	@sText, @nLine
		end
	close c_comm
	deallocate c_comm


    return @sComm

end

CREATE  function REPGETCOMPDATE (@dUdate datetime)
RETURNS nvarchar(30)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sFmtdate           nvarchar(30)
    DECLARE @sYearWithCentury   nvarchar(4)
    DECLARE @sMonth             nvarchar(2)
    DECLARE @sDay               nvarchar(2)

    SELECT @sYearWithCentury = cast( DATEPART(yyyy, @dUdate) as nvarchar(4))
    SELECT @sMonth = cast( DATEPART(mm, @dUdate) as nvarchar(2))
    SELECT @sDay = cast( DATEPART(dd, @dUdate) as nvarchar(2))

    IF cast(@sMonth as int) < 10
        SET @sMonth = '0' + @sMonth

    IF cast(@sDay as int) < 10
        SET @sDay = '0' + @sDay

    SET @sFmtdate = @sYearWithCentury + '-' + @sMonth + '-' + @sDay
    RETURN @sFmtdate
END

CREATE function REPGETFMTDATE (@sUsr nvarchar(255),
							   @dUdate datetime)
RETURNS nvarchar(30)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sLocdtfmt nvarchar(30)

    IF CHARINDEX( 'MON', @sLocdtfmt ) > 0

        FROM ( SELECT DATEPART( month, @dUdate ) u1, usr_lang u2 FROM r5users WHERE usr_code = @sUsr ) u;

    RETURN @sFmtdate
END

create function REPGETHIERCHILD(    @sType  nvarchar(10),
                                    @sCodev nvarchar(63),

returns int
as
begin
    declare @nReturn    int

    set @sDatabase = cast( DB_NAME() as varchar(128) )

    set @sConcat = @sCodev + @sOrg

            execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'REPGETHIERCHILD_OBJ', @sType, @sConcat, @sCodev, @sOrg

        end

            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <= 0

        end

    if @sType = N'LOC2'

            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <= 0

            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <= 0

        end

            IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <= 0

    IF @sType = N'STC3'

            IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <= 0

        END

        BEGIN

            IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <= 0

    IF @sType = N'STC5'

CREATE  FUNCTION REPGETHIERCODE (@sRectype nvarchar(25),
                      @sCodev nvarchar(200),
                      @sChkcodev nvarchar(200),
                      @nCoden int,
                      @nChkcoden int,
                      @sOrg nvarchar(200),
                      @nSeqno int)  
RETURNS nvarchar(200) AS
BEGIN 
    declare @nHiercount int
    declare @sOutcode nvarchar(200)
    declare @sVorg nvarchar(200)
    declare @sRtype nvarchar(200)

    set @sRtype = @sRectype

    if @sRectype = N'LOC1'
        begin
            select @sOutcode = a.loc_code
            from  (SELECT loc_code, nLevel
                    FROM DBO.F_GET_REPGETHIERCODE_LOC1_HIER(@sCodev,@sOrg)) a
            where a.nLevel = @nSeqno 
            if @sOutcode is null
                set @sOutcode = N' '
        end


    if @sRectype = N'LOC2'
        begin
            select @sOutcode = a.loc_code
            from  (SELECT loc_code, nLevel
                    FROM DBO.F_GET_REPGETHIERCODE_LOC2_HIER(@sCodev)) a
            where a.nLevel = @nSeqno 

            if @sOutcode is null
                set @sOutcode = N' '
        end

    if @sRectype = N'LOC3'
        begin
            select @sOutcode = a.loc_code, @sVorg = a.loc_org
            from  (SELECT loc_code, loc_org, nLevel
                    FROM DBO.F_GET_REPGETHIERCODE_LOC3_HIER(@sCodev)) a
            where a.nLevel = @nSeqno 
            if @sOutcode is not null
                begin
                    IF @sVorg <> @sOrg 
                        set @sOutcode = @sOutcode  +  N'   ('  +  @sVorg  +  N')' 
                end
            else
                set @sOutcode = ' '
        end


    if @sRectype = N'LOC4'
        begin
			select @sOutcode = a.loc_code 
            from  (SELECT loc_code, loc_org, nLevel 
            FROM DBO.F_GET_REPGETHIERCODE_LOC4_HIER(@sCodev)) a 
            where a.loc_code = @sChkcodev 
            if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                set @sOutcode = N' '    
            else
                set @sOutcode = N'x'
        end

    if @sRectype = N'LOC5'
        begin
			 --use the same hierarchial query as LOC4.  The difference is in the where clause.
            select @sOutcode = a.loc_code
            from  (SELECT loc_code, loc_org, nLevel
            FROM DBO.F_GET_REPGETHIERCODE_LOC4_HIER(@sCodev)) a
            where a.nLevel = @nSeqno
            if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                set @sOutcode = N' '    
            else
                set @sOutcode = N'x'
        end
 

    if @sRectype = 'OBJ1'
        begin
            select @nHiercount = count(1)  from (select stc_child from  dbo.F_GET_REPGETHIERCODE_OBJ1_HIER(@sCodev) 
                                                    union 
                                                    select @sCodev ) a
            where stc_child = @sChkcodev


            if @nHiercount = 0
                set @sOutcode = N' '
            else
                set @sOutcode = N'x'
        end

    if @sRectype = N'STC1'
        begin
            select @nHiercount = count(1)  from r5events 
            where @sOrg in (select stc_child_type + N'#' + stc_child from F_GET_REPGETHIERCODE_STC1_HIER(@sCodev, @sChkcodev))
            if @nHiercount > 0
                set @sOutcode = @sCodev
            else
                set @sOutcode = N' '
        end

    if @sRectype = N'STC4'
        begin
            select @nHiercount = count(1)  from r5objects 
            where obj_code + N'#' + obj_org 
            in (select stc_parent + N'#' + stc_parent_org from dbo.F_GET_REPGETHIERCODE_STC4_HIER(@sChkcodev,@sOrg))
            AND obj_obrtype = N'S'
            AND obj_notused <> N'+'
            AND obj_code   = @sCodev

            if @nHiercount > 0
                set @sOutcode = @sChkcodev
            else
                set @sOutcode = N' '
        end

    if @sRectype = N'STC5'
        begin
            select @nHiercount = count(1)  from r5objects 
            where obj_code + N'#' + obj_org 
            in (select stc_parent + N'#' + stc_parent_org from dbo.F_GET_REPGETHIERCODE_STC4_HIER(@sChkcodev,@sOrg))
            AND obj_obrtype = N'S'
            AND obj_code   = @sCodev

            if @nHiercount > 0
                set @sOutcode = @sChkcodev
            else
                set @sOutcode = N' '
        end

    if @sRectype = N'STC6'
        begin
            select @nHiercount = count(1)  from dbo.F_GET_REPGETHIERCODE_STC_HIER(@sChkcodev)
            WHERE  stc_parent      LIKE @sCodev
            AND    stc_parent_org  = @sOrg
            AND    stc_parentrtype = 'L'

            if @nHiercount > 0
                set @sOutcode = 'TRUE'
            else
                set @sOutcode = 'FALSE'
      end

     if @sRectype = N'STC7'
        begin
            select @nHiercount = count(1)  from dbo.F_GET_REPGETHIERCODE_STC_HIER(@sChkcodev)
            WHERE  stc_parent      LIKE @sCodev
            AND    stc_parent_org  = @sOrg
            AND    stc_parentrtype = 'P'

            if @nHiercount > 0
                set @sOutcode = 'TRUE'
            else
                set @sOutcode = 'FALSE'
        end

return (@sOutcode)

END

create function DBO.REPGETHOURS(@nSeconds integer)
returns nvarchar(15)
as
begin
        declare    @nHrs        integer
        declare    @nMinutes    integer
        declare    @nSec        integer
        declare    @sFmt_val    nvarchar(15)

        if @nSeconds IS NULL
             return NULL

        set @nHrs     = FLOOR(@nSeconds / 3600)
        set @nMinutes = FLOOR((@nSeconds % 3600) / 60)
        set @nSec     = ((@nSeconds % 3600) % 60)

        set @sFmt_val = CASE WHEN LEN(LTRIM(STR(@nHrs))) = 1 THEN STUFF(LTRIM(STR(@nHrs)), 1, 0, '0') ELSE LTRIM(STR(@nHrs)) END + ':' 
                        + CASE WHEN LEN(LTRIM(STR(@nMinutes))) = 1 THEN STUFF(LTRIM(STR(@nMinutes)), 1, 0, '0') ELSE LTRIM(STR(@nMinutes)) END + ':' 
                        + CASE WHEN LEN(LTRIM(STR(@nSec))) = 1 THEN STUFF(LTRIM(STR(@nSec)), 1, 0, '0') ELSE LTRIM(STR(@nSec)) END

        return @sFmt_val
end

create function REPGETPARAMDESC(@sLang nvarchar(3), @sRentity nvarchar(4),
                          @sCode  nvarchar(60), @sRtype nvarchar(4), @sType nvarchar(4))
returns nvarchar(255)
as
begin

    declare @sChk		nvarchar(4)
    declare @sDeforg	nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
    declare @sCod		nvarchar(100)
    declare @sOrg		nvarchar(100)
    declare @sHorg		nvarchar(100)
    declare @sTxt		nvarchar(500)
    declare @sNewcod	nvarchar(100)

	if @sRentity IS NULL 
		RETURN NULL

	if charindex(N'%' , @sCode ) <> 0 
		RETURN NULL
	
	if charindex(N'_' , @sCode) <> 0 
		RETURN NULL
	
	if @sRentity IN ( N'PORD', N'OBJ',  N'CLAS', N'CAT', N'INV', N'PART', N'COMP', N'EIV', N'RMA' ) 
		begin
			set @sDeforg = dbo.o7dflt2( N'DEFORG')
			if charindex( N'#' , @sCode ) > 0 
				begin
					set @sCod = SUBSTRING( @sCode, 1, charindex( N'#' , @sCode  ) - 1 )
					set @sOrg = SUBSTRING( @sCode, charindex( N'#', @sCode  ) + 1, len(@sCode) - charindex( N'#', @sCode  ) )
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sCod = @sCode
					set @sOrg = @sDeforg
				end

			if @sRentity = N'CAT' 
				set @sOrg = @sDeforg
			else
				begin
					if dbo.o7getmos( @sRentity ) = N'-' 
						set @sOrg = @sDeforg
					else
						begin
							set @sTxt = RTRIM(dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(@sLang, @sRentity, @sCode, @sRtype, @sType ) )
							if @sTxt <> N'?' 
									RETURN( N'[ ' + @sTxt + ' ]' )
							else
								begin
									set @sHorg = @sOrg
									if    @sRentity = N'OBJ'  
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = obj_org
											FROM   r5objects
											WHERE  obj_code = @sCod
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
									if @sRentity = N'PORD' 
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = ord_org
											FROM   r5orders
											WHERE  ord_code = @sCod
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
									if @sRentity = N'CLAS' 
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = cls_org
											FROM   r5classes
											WHERE  cls_code = @sCod
											AND    cls_rentity = @sRtype
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
									if @sRentity = N'INV'  
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = inv_org
											FROM   r5invoices
											WHERE  inv_code = @sCod
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
									if @sRentity = N'EIV'  
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = eiv_org
											FROM   r5extinvoices
											WHERE  eiv_code = @sCod
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
									if @sRentity = N'PART' 
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = par_org
											FROM   r5parts
											WHERE  par_code = @sCod
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
									if @sRentity = N'COMP' 
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = com_org
											FROM   r5companies
											WHERE  com_code = @sCod
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
									if @sRentity = N'RMA'  
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = rma_org
											FROM   r5rma
											WHERE  rma_code = @sCod
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
								end
						end
				end
			set @sNewcod = @sCod + N'#' + @sOrg
			RETURN( N'[ ' + RTRIM(dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(@sLang, @sRentity, @sNewcod, @sRtype, @sType)) + ' ]')
		end

    RETURN( N'[ ' + RTRIM(dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(@sLang, @sRentity, @sCode, @sRtype, @sType)) + ' ]')
end

CREATE  FUNCTION DBO.REPGETPARENTCHILDLOC (@LOC  nvarchar(30),@LOC_ORG  nvarchar(15),@R5_ORG NVARCHAR(15))
       RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @result1    NVARCHAR(4000)
	DECLARE @TEMP_LOC NVARCHAR(256)
	DECLARE  LOC_CURSOR CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT (CASE  @R5_ORG WHEN LOC_ORG THEN LOC_CODE 
                        ELSE LOC_CODE +  N' (' +  LOC_ORG +  N')' END) DISP_LOCATION 
                        FROM DBO.R5REP_LOCATION_HIERARCHY_1( @LOC,  @LOC_ORG);
	OPEN LOC_CURSOR;
	FETCH  NEXT FROM LOC_CURSOR INTO @TEMP_LOC; 
	SET @result1 = ''
	WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS=0) 
	BEGIN 
		SET @result1 = @result1 + @TEMP_LOC + CHAR(13)
		FETCH NEXT FROM LOC_CURSOR INTO @TEMP_LOC
	END 
	CLOSE LOC_CURSOR
	DEALLOCATE LOC_CURSOR
	RETURN @result1
END

CREATE  FUNCTION dbo.REPGETRFQLINEDUEDATE(@sRFQ NVARCHAR(30),@nLINE NUMERIC,@sLTYPE NVARCHAR(4),@dDDATE DATETIME)
RETURNS DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @dDUEDATE  DATETIME
DECLARE @sOPT      NVARCHAR(1)
SELECT  @sOPT=RFQ_RESPONSEOPT  FROM R5RFQUOTATIONS WHERE RFQ_CODE=@sRFQ
IF(@sOPT='I' OR @sLTYPE='ST' OR @sLTYPE='SF' OR @sOPT='Q') 
           SET @dDUEDATE = @dDDATE
ELSE
BEGIN
       IF @sLTYPE LIKE 'P%' 
          SELECT  @dDUEDATE=MIN(L.RLI_DUEDATE) 
          FROM R5RFQLINES L,(SELECT RLI_PART,RLI_PART_ORG FROM R5RFQLINES WHERE RLI_RFQLINE=@nLINE) T
          WHERE L.RLI_PART=T.RLI_PART
          AND L.RLI_PART_ORG=T.RLI_PART_ORG
          AND L.RLI_RTYPE LIKE 'P%'
          AND L.RLI_RFQ=@sRFQ
       ELSE IF @sLTYPE='RE' 
          SELECT @dDUEDATE=MIN(L.RLI_DUEDATE) 
          FROM R5RFQLINES L,(SELECT RLI_PART,RLI_PART_ORG FROM R5RFQLINES WHERE RLI_RFQLINE=@nLINE) T
          WHERE L.RLI_PART=T.RLI_PART
          AND L.RLI_PART_ORG=T.RLI_PART_ORG
          AND L.RLI_RTYPE = 'RE'
          AND L.RLI_RFQ=@sRFQ
       ELSE
          SELECT @dDUEDATE=MIN(L.RLI_DUEDATE) 
          FROM R5RFQLINES L,(SELECT RLI_TASK,RLI_TRADE FROM R5RFQLINES WHERE RLI_RFQLINE=@nLINE) T
          WHERE L.RLI_TASK=T.RLI_TASK
          AND L.RLI_TRADE=T.RLI_TRADE
          AND L.RLI_RTYPE = 'SH'
          AND L.RLI_RFQ=@sRFQ           
      
END 

RETURN @dDUEDATE
END

create function DBO.REPGETVALIDEXCH (@sRepcur nvarchar(3), @sOrg nvarchar(15))
returns int
as
begin
    declare @nCurrexch       numeric(30,6)
    declare @nReportingcurr  nvarchar(3)
    declare @nReturn         int

    if @sOrg is null
       set @nReturn = 0

    if CHARINDEX(N'%', @sRepcur) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(N'_', @sRepcur) > 0 
       SELECT @nReportingcurr = INS_DESC FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'DEFCURR'
    else
       set @nReportingcurr = @sRepcur

    SELECT @nCurrexch = crr_exch
    FROM R5EXCHRATES 
    WHERE crr_curr = @nReportingcurr 
    AND crr_orgcurr = DBO.REPORGDEFCUR(@sOrg) 
    AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dbo.O7gttime2(@sOrg), N'DD') BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE (crr_start, N'DD') AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE (crr_end, N'DD')

    if @nCurrexch is null and @nReportingcurr <> DBO.REPORGDEFCUR(@sOrg)
       set @nReturn = 1
    else
       set @nReturn = 0

    return @nReturn
end

CREATE function REPGETVMRSDESC ( @sLang nvarchar(4),
                         @sSyslevel   nvarchar(255),
                         @sAsmlevel   nvarchar(255),
                         @sComplevel  nvarchar(255))
RETURNS nvarchar(300)
AS
BEGIN
    declare @sVmrsdesc nvarchar(300)
    declare @sDesText nvarchar(300)

        IF  @sSyslevel is not null 
            begin
                SELECT  @sDesText = D.DES_TEXT 
                FROM R5DESCRIPTIONS D,  R5CODESTRUCTURE C
                WHERE C.CSR_CODE =  D.DES_CODE
                AND C.CSR_RENTITY = D.DES_RTYPE
                AND D.DES_RENTITY = 'CLVL'
                AND D.DES_RTYPE   = 'ACT'
                AND D.DES_LANG     = @sLang
                AND C.CSR_STRUCTURE = dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING(@sSyslevel + '.' + @sAsmlevel + '.' + @sComplevel, '.' )

                IF @sAsmlevel IS NULL 
                    set @sVmrsdesc = @sSyslevel  + N'    ' +  @sDesText
                ELSE
                    begin
                        IF @sComplevel IS NULL 
                            set @sVmrsdesc = @sSyslevel + N'/' + @sAsmlevel + N'  ' + @sDesText
                        ELSE
                            set @sVmrsdesc = @sSyslevel + N'/' + @sAsmlevel + N'/' + @sComplevel + N'  ' + @sDesText
                    end
            end
        else
            set @sVmrsdesc = N''

    RETURN @sVmrsdesc
END

CREATE function REPGET_CLASS_LOC_HIER ( @sClass  nvarchar(30) )
returns @tReturn table( loc_parent      nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        loc_parent_org  nvarchar(15)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        loc_code        nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        loc_org         nvarchar(15)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        nLevel          int  )
as
begin
    declare @nLevel       int
    declare @sParent      nvarchar(30)
    declare @sParentorg   nvarchar(15)
    declare @sCode        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOrg         nvarchar(15)

    declare @tStack table ( loc_parent      nvarchar(30),
                            loc_parent_org  nvarchar(15),
                            loc_code        nvarchar(30),
                            loc_org         nvarchar(15),
                            LevelID         int )

    if @sClass = N'%'
      SET @sClass = N'$'

    INSERT INTO @tStack 
        select  loc_parent,
                loc_parent_org,
                loc_code,
                loc_org,
                1 
        from    r5locations
        where   loc_class like @sClass

    SET @nLevel = 1

    WHILE @nLevel > 0
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                BEGIN
                    select  @sCode      = loc_code,
                            @sOrg       = loc_org,
                            @sParent    = loc_parent,
                            @sParentorg = loc_parent_org
                    from  @tStack 
                    where LevelID = @nLevel

                    insert into @tReturn values ( @sParent, @sParentorg, @sCode, @sOrg, @nLevel )
                    delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND loc_code = @sCode and loc_org = @sOrg
                    insert into @tStack select  loc_parent,
                                                loc_parent_org,
                                                loc_code,
                                                loc_org,
                                                @nLevel + 1
                                         from   r5locations
                                         where  loc_parent      = @sCode and
                                                loc_parent_org  = @sOrg
                    IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
                        SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                END
            ELSE
                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
        END

    return
end

create function REPGET_STCORG_HIER( @sObject nvarchar(30),
                                    @sObjectorg nvarchar(15),
                                    @sR5org nvarchar(15),
                                    @sObjtype nvarchar(4) )
returns @tReturn table( 
        stc_child nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
        stc_child_org nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN ,
        stc_parentrtype nvarchar(4) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
    DECLARE @nLevel             int
    DECLARE @sCurrentChild      nvarchar(30)
    DECLARE @sCurrentOrg        nvarchar(15)
    DECLARE @sParentRType       nvarchar(4)

    DECLARE @tStack table ( stc_child nvarchar(30), stc_child_org nvarchar(15), stc_parentrtype nvarchar(4), LevelID int )

    INSERT INTO @tStack select stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_parentrtype, 1 
            FROM    r5structures s
            WHERE   s.stc_childtype  LIKE @sObjtype
            AND     s.stc_parent     LIKE @sObject
            AND     s.stc_parent_org = CASE WHEN @sObjectorg = N'%' THEN @sR5org ELSE @sObjectorg END 

    SET @nLevel = 1

    WHILE @nLevel > 0
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @sCurrentChild = stc_child, 
                           @sCurrentOrg = stc_child_org,
                           @sParentRType = stc_parentrtype
                    FROM   @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel

                    INSERT INTO @tReturn values ( @sCurrentChild, @sCurrentOrg, @sParentRType )
                    DELETE FROM @tStack
                           WHERE LevelID = @nLevel
                           AND stc_child = @sCurrentChild
                           AND stc_child_org = @sCurrentOrg
                           AND stc_parentrtype = @sParentRType

                    INSERT INTO @tStack select stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_parentrtype, @nLevel + 1 
                    FROM r5structures s
                    WHERE s.stc_parent = @sCurrentChild
                    AND s.stc_parent_org = @sCurrentOrg

                    IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
                        SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                END
            ELSE
                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
        END

    return
end

body:
create function REPONREQUIQTY ( @sPart  nvarchar(30),
                                @sOrg   nvarchar(15),
                                @sStore nvarchar(30)  )
returns numeric(30,6)
as
begin
    declare @nOnrequi1      numeric(30,6)
    declare @nOnrequi2      numeric(30,6)
    declare @nIntransid1    numeric(30,6)
    declare @nIntransid2    numeric(30,6)
    declare @nReturnval     numeric(30,6)
    
    set @nReturnval = 0.0

    SELECT @nOnrequi1 = isnull(ore_qty,0)
        FROM   r5onrequi
        WHERE  ore_part     = @sPart
        AND    ore_part_org = @sOrg
        AND    ore_store    = @sStore
        if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
            set @nOnrequi1 = 0
    
        SELECT @nOnrequi2 = SUM( isnull(r.rql_qty,0) - isnull( r.rql_recvqty, 0 ) )
        FROM   r5requislines  r,
              r5requisitions q
        WHERE  q.req_code     = r.rql_req
        AND    r.rql_rstatus IN ( N'U', N'R', N'A' )
        AND    r.rql_active   = N'+'
        AND    q.req_rtype    = N'STST'
        AND    r.rql_part     = @sPart
        AND    r.rql_part_org = @sOrg
        AND    q.req_fromcode = @sStore
        if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
            set @nOnrequi2 = 0
    
        SELECT @nIntransid1 = sum( isnull(tst_qty,0) )
        FROM   r5transtock
        WHERE  tst_part      = @sPart
        AND    tst_part_org  = @sOrg
        AND    tst_store     = @sStore
        AND    tst_torentity = N'STOR'
        AND    tst_req IS NOT NULL
        if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
            set @nIntransid1 = 0
    
        SELECT @nIntransid2 = sum( isnull(tst_qty,0) )
        FROM   r5transtock
        WHERE  tst_part      = @sPart
        AND    tst_part_org  = @sOrg
        AND    tst_tocode    = @sStore
        AND    tst_torentity = N'STOR'
        AND    tst_req IS NOT NULL
        if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
            set @nIntransid2 = 0
    
        set @nReturnval = ( isnull( @nOnrequi1, 0 ) - isnull( @nOnrequi2, 0 ) + isnull( @nIntransid1, 0 ) - isnull( @nIntransid2, 0 ) )

    return @nReturnval
end

name: REPUZBANA_GETBDS_HIERARCHY2
body:
create function REPUZBANA_GETBDS_HIERARCHY2 (   @sBuscode       nvarchar(17) )
returns @tReturn table( buscode nvarchar(17)            COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                                                buslevel        numeric(1),
                                                busorg  nvarchar(15)            COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                                                nLevel          int )
as
begin
        declare @nLevel                 int
        declare @sParent                nvarchar(17)
        declare @sCode                  nvarchar(17)
        declare @sOrg                   nvarchar(15)
        declare @nBuslevel                      numeric(1)

        declare @tStack table ( buscode         nvarchar(17),
                                                        buslevel        numeric(1),
                                                        busorg          nvarchar(15),
                                                        busparent       nvarchar(17),
                                                        LevelID int )

        INSERT INTO @tStack
                select  s.bus_code,
                                s.bus_level,
                                s.bus_org,
                                s.bus_parent,
                                1
                  from  r5budgetstructure s
                 where  s.bus_code              = @sBuscode     and
                                NOT EXISTS ( SELECT bus_parent
                            FROM   r5budgetstructure s2
                            WHERE  s2.bus_parent = s.bus_code )

        SET @nLevel = 1

        WHILE @nLevel > 0
                BEGIN
                        IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                                BEGIN
                                        select  @sParent        = busparent,
                                                        @sCode  = buscode,
                                                        @sOrg = busorg,
                                                        @nBuslevel = buslevel
                                          from  @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
                                        insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @nBuslevel, @sOrg,  @nLevel)
                                        delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND buscode = @sCode
                                        insert into @tStack     select  s.bus_code,
                                                                                                s.bus_level,
                                                                                                s.bus_org,
                                                                                                s.bus_parent,
                                                                                                @nLevel + 1
                                                                                  from  r5budgetstructure s
                                                                                 where  s.bus_parent    = @sCode and
                                                                                                NOT EXISTS ( SELECT bus_parent
                                                                                                FROM   r5budgetstructure s2
                                                                                                WHERE  s2.bus_parent = s.bus_code )

                                        IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
                                                SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                                END
                        ELSE
                                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
                END

        return
end

body:
create function REPUZBANA_SUBREPORT_TYPE(@sSELBUDGET nvarchar(17), @sSELYEAR nvarchar(8), @sSELCOSTFASE nvarchar(8), @sSELCOSTSORT nvarchar(80), @sSELPERIODFROM nvarchar(4), @sSELPERIODTO nvarchar(4),
@sSELORG nvarchar(15), @sR5ORG nvarchar(15),  @sR5LANG nvarchar(2))
returns nvarchar(15)
as
begin
    declare @sSubreptype        nvarchar(10) --= ' '
    declare @sChk               nvarchar(4) --= '0'
    declare @sCostface          nvarchar(8)--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
    declare @sCostsort          nvarchar(8)--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
    declare @dCurdate           DATETIME
    declare @sBudget            nvarchar(17)--r5budgetdetails.bdt_budget%TYPE = @sSELBUDGET
    declare @sYear              nvarchar(8)--r5periods.acp_year%TYPE = @sSELYEAR
    declare @sPeriod_from       nvarchar(4)--r5periods.acp_period%TYPE = @sSELPERIODFROM
    declare @sPeriod_to         nvarchar(4)--r5periods.acp_period%TYPE = @sSELPERIODTO
    declare @dSEL_STARTDATE     DATETIME
    declare @dSEL_ENDDATE       DATETIME
    declare @nSEL_SEQ_START     INTEGER
    declare @nSEL_SEQ_END       INTEGER
    declare @bContinue          bit
    declare @nReturn            integer
    declare @sDatabase        varchar(128)

    declare @dDummydate     DATETIME
    declare @dYear_start    DATETIME
    declare @dYear_end      DATETIME
    declare @nPeriods       INTEGER
    declare @dSys_date      DATETIME
    declare @sStmt          nvarchar(200)

    declare @s_costsortcode       nvarchar(100)


    set @sChk = N'0'
    set @sSubreptype = N' '

    set @sBudget = @sSELBUDGET
    set @sYear = @sSELYEAR
    set @sPeriod_from = @sSELPERIODFROM
    set @sPeriod_to =  @sSELPERIODTO

    IF @sBudget = N'%'
        set @sBudget = null

    IF @sPeriod_from = N'%'
        set @sPeriod_from = null

    IF @sPeriod_to = N'%'
        set @sPeriod_to = null

    IF @sSELORG IS NOT NULL AND @sSELORG <> N'%'
        set @dCurdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(  dbo.REPUZBANA_REPGETTIME( @sSELORG ), N'DD' )
    ELSE
        set @dCurdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(  dbo.REPUZBANA_REPGETTIME( @sR5ORG ), N'DD' )

--****** start get dates

    IF @sSELORG IS NOT NULL AND @sSELORG <> N'%'
        set @dSys_date = dbo.REPUZBANA_REPGETTIME(@sSELORG)
    ELSE
        set @dSys_date = dbo.REPUZBANA_REPGETTIME(@sR5ORG)



    IF @sPeriod_from IS NULL OR @sPeriod_to IS NULL
        begin
            SELECT @dYear_start = acy_start, @dYear_end = acy_end, @nPeriods = cal_periods FROM r5calendars, r5years WHERE acy_cal = cal_code AND acy_year = @sYear

            IF @sBudget IS NOT NULL
                begin
                    SELECT @dSEL_STARTDATE = coalesce( min(p.acp_start), @dSys_date ), @dSEL_ENDDATE = coalesce( max(p.acp_end), @dSys_date ),
                           @nSEL_SEQ_START = min(p.acp_seqno), @nSEL_SEQ_END = max(p.acp_seqno)
                    FROM r5periods p
                    WHERE p.acp_year = @sYear
                    AND p.acp_period IN (
                      SELECT bd.bdt_period
                      FROM r5budgetdetails bd
                      WHERE bd.bdt_period = p.acp_period
                      AND   bd.bdt_budget IN
                        (SELECT buscode FROM dbo.O7REPUZBANA_GETBDS_HIERARCHY1(@sBudget))
                      )
                end
                END

   -- Retrieve the start date of the start period.
    IF @sPeriod_from IS NOT NULL
        SELECT @dSEL_STARTDATE = acp_start,
              @dDummydate = acp_end,
              @nSEL_SEQ_START = acp_seqno
        FROM   r5periods
        WHERE  acp_year   = @sYear
        AND    acp_period = @sPeriod_from
    ELSE
        begin
            IF @sBudget IS  NULL OR @dSEL_STARTDATE IS NULL
                begin
                    set @dSEL_STARTDATE = @dYear_start
                    set @nSEL_SEQ_START = 1
                end
        end

   -- Retrieve the end date of the end period.
    IF @sPeriod_to IS NOT NULL
        SELECT @dDummydate = acp_start,
              @dSEL_ENDDATE = acp_end,
              @nSEL_SEQ_END = acp_seqno
        FROM   r5periods
        WHERE  acp_year   = @sYear
        AND    acp_period = @sPeriod_to
    ELSE
        begin
            IF @sBudget IS  NULL OR @dSEL_ENDDATE IS NULL
                begin
                    set @dSEL_ENDDATE = @dYear_end
                    set @nSEL_SEQ_END = @nPeriods
                end
        end

--****** end get dates




     SELECT @s_costsortcode = des_code
        FROM r5descriptions
       WHERE
         des_rentity = 'UCOD'
         AND des_lang = @sR5LANG
         AND des_rtype = 'CSTP'
         AND des_text = @sSELCOSTSORT


    SET @sCostface = dbo.o7ccode ( @sSELCOSTFASE, N'CSST' )

    SET @sCostsort = dbo.o7ccode ( @s_costsortcode, N'CSTP' )


   IF @sCostface NOT IN ( N'ACT', N'EST', N'PNO', N'ORD', N'REM' )
      set @sCostface = N'EST'

    set @bContinue = 1
    /* Determine the type of report. */
    IF    @sCostsort = N'1'
        begin
            set @sSubreptype = @sCostface+N'LAB'
            set @bContinue = 0
        end
    IF @sCostsort = N'2'
        begin
            set @sSubreptype = @sCostface+N'MAT'
            set @bContinue = 0
        end
    IF @sCostsort = N'3'
        begin
            set @sSubreptype = @sCostface+N'HIR'
            set @bContinue = 0
        end
    IF @sCostsort = N'4'
        begin
            set @sSubreptype = @sCostface+N'DMA'
            set @bContinue = 0
        end
    IF @sCostsort = N'5'
        begin
            set @sSubreptype = @sCostface+N'FIX'
            set @bContinue = 0
        end
    IF @sCostsort = N'6'
        begin
            set @sSubreptype = @sCostface+N'TOL'
            set @bContinue = 0
        end

    If @bContinue = 1
         set @sSubreptype = @sCostface+N'LAB'


    IF @sCostface = N'REM'
        begin
            IF @dCurdate < @dSEL_STARTDATE
                begin
                    /* Remaining costs in the future equal the estimated costs. */
                    IF @sCostsort IN ('1', N'2')
                        set @sSubreptype = N'EST'+ SUBSTRING(@sSubreptype, 4,3)
                    ELSE
                        set @sSubreptype = N'ORD'+ SUBSTRING(@sSubreptype, 4,3)
                end
        end

    RETURN (@sSubreptype)
end

body:
CREATE procedure REPWZCALA  @sR5Func    nvarchar(30),
                            @sR5Lang    nvarchar(30),
                            @sDeforg    nvarchar(30),
                            @sUsr       nvarchar(255),
                            @sMrc       nvarchar(15),
                            @sSystem    nvarchar(30),
                            @sObject    nvarchar(30),
                            @sClass     nvarchar(15),
                            @sCat       nvarchar(30),
                            @sCrit      nvarchar(8),
                            @nCal       numeric(30,0),
                            @sPass      nvarchar(100),
                            @sNoncon    nvarchar(100),
                            @sIncPF     nvarchar(100),
                            @sIncPR     nvarchar(100),
                            @sIncI      nvarchar(100),
                            @sOrg       nvarchar(15),
                            @sSdate     nvarchar(60),
                            @sEdate     nvarchar(60),
                            @sCurrUser  nvarchar(255),
                            @r5role     nvarchar(30)
AS

    SET NOCOUNT ON
    SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

    declare @sSess        nvarchar(40)
    declare @sR5user      nvarchar(255)
    declare @sR5function  nvarchar(6)
    declare @sR5language  nvarchar(2)
    declare @sR5deforg    nvarchar(15)
    declare @dSdate       datetime
    declare @dEdate       datetime
    declare @nReturn      integer

    declare @sSelect      nvarchar(4000) 
    declare @sFrom        nvarchar(1000) 
    declare @sWhereClause nvarchar(2000) 
    declare @sOrderBy     nvarchar(200)
    declare @sSelectUnion nvarchar(4000) 

    declare @sSQL         nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sSQLUnion    nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sUpdate1     nvarchar(4000)
     declare @deptsec        nvarchar(400)

    SELECT @deptsec=INS_DESC FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = 'DEPTSEC'


    set @sSelect          = ''
    set @sFrom            = ''
    set @sWhereClause     = ''
    set @sOrderBy         = ''
    set @sSelectUnion     = ''

    set @sSess            = cast(@@spid as nvarchar(38)) + dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(getdate(),N'MISS')

    set @sR5user          = @sUsr
    set @sR5function      = @sR5Func
    set @sR5language      = @sR5Lang
    set @sR5deforg        = @sDeforg

    if @sSdate = N'%'
        set @dSdate = dbo.to_date(N'1900-01-01' , N'YYYY-MM-DD')
    else
        set @dSdate = dbo.to_date(@sSdate , 'YYYY-MM-DD')

    if @sEdate = N'%'
        set @dEdate = dbo.to_date(N'2099-12-31' ,N'YYYY-MM-DD')
    else
        set @dEdate = dbo.to_date(@sEdate, N'YYYY-MM-DD')

    execute @nReturn = o7wrcala @sSess, @sUsr, @sMrc, @sSystem, @sObject, @sClass, @sCat, @sCrit, @nCal, @sPass, @sNoncon, @sIncPF, @sIncPR, @sIncI, @sOrg, @dSdate, @dEdate, @r5role
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
             IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 
                 ROLLBACK
                 return -1
             end

    set @sSelect = 'W.WRC_SESSION, ' + 
                   'W.WRC_MRC, ' +
                   'DBO.REPGETDESC(@sR5language, ''MRC'', W.WRC_MRC, NULL, NULL) MRC_DESC, ' + 
                   'W.WRC_OBJECT, ' +
                   'DBO.REPGETDESC(@sR5language, ''OBJ'', W.WRC_OBJECT + N''#'' + W.WRC_OBJECT_ORG, NULL, NULL) OBJ_DESC, ' +
                   'W.WRC_OBJECT_ORG, ' +
                   'O.OBJ_CRITICALITY, ' +
                   'O.OBJ_CLASS, ' +
                   'O.OBJ_CATEGORY, ' +
                   'DBO.REPFMTWHOLENUMLOCALE(@sR5user, @sR5deforg, W.WRC_RECNO) WRC_RECNO, ' +
                   'W.WRC_EVENT, ' +
                   'E.EVT_PPM, ' +
                   'DBO.REPFMTWHOLENUMLOCALE(@sR5user, @sR5deforg, E.EVT_FREQ) EVT_FREQ, ' +
                   'E.EVT_PERIODUOM, ' +
                   'DBO.REPGETFMTDATELOCALE(@sR5user, @sR5deforg, E.EVT_COMPLETED) EVT_COMPLETED, ' +
                   'DBO.REPEVTSYSTEMS(@sR5deforg, W.WRC_EVENT) SYSTEM_DATA, ' +
			'dbo.REPGETFMTDATILOCALE( @sR5user , @sR5deforg,(dbo.REPGETSYSDATE(@sR5deforg ))) AS CURDATETIME, ' +
                   '(CASE WHEN E.EVT_MULTIEQUIP = N''+'' THEN DBO.REPGETTEXT(''' + @sR5function + ''' ,''' + @sR5language + ''', 41)  WHEN E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT IS NOT NULL THEN  DBO.REPGETTEXT(''' + @sR5function + ''' ,''' + @sR5language + ''', 40)  ELSE NULL END) ME_MEC , ' +
                   ''' '' DUMMY '

    set @sFrom = ' R5EVENTS E, R5OBJECTS O, R5WRCALA W '

    set @sWhereClause = ' W.WRC_EVENT = E.EVT_CODE AND ' +
                        'E.EVT_OBJECT = O.OBJ_CODE AND ' +
                        'E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG = O.OBJ_ORG AND ' +
                        'W.WRC_SESSION = @sSess AND ' +
                        'O.OBJ_ORG IN (SELECT UOG_ORG FROM R5USERORGANIZATION, R5PERMISSIONS WHERE UOG_USER = @sR5user AND UOG_GROUP = PRM_GROUP AND PRM_FUNCTION = @sR5function AND PRM_SELECT = ''?'') '
			+' AND ( ('''+ @deptsec +''' = N''ON'' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM R5DEPARTMENTSECURITY WHERE DSE_USER = @sR5User   AND DSE_MRC = E.EVT_MRC ) ) OR ( '''+ @deptsec  +'''= N''OFF'')) '

    IF @sR5User <> UPPER( COALESCE( @sCurrUser, '#' ) )
       SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND 1=0 '

    set @sOrderBy = ' ORDER BY WRC_MRC, WRC_OBJECT, WRC_OBJECT_ORG, WRC_RECNO '

    set @sSelectUnion = ''' '' WRC_SESSION, ' +
                        ''' '' WRC_MRC, ' +
                        ''' '' MRC_DESC, ' +
                        ''' '' WRC_OBJECT, ' +
                        ''' '' OBJ_DESC, ' +
                        ''' '' WRC_OBJECT_ORG, ' +
                        ''' '' OBJ_CRITICALITY, ' +
                        ''' '' OBJ_CLASS, ' +
                        ''' '' OBJ_CATEGORY, ' +
                        ''' '' WRC_RECNO, ' +
                        ''' '' WRC_EVENT, ' +
                        ''' '' EVT_PPM, ' +
                        ''' '' EVT_FREQ, ' +
                        ''' '' EVT_PERIODUOM, ' +
                        ''' '' EVT_COMPLETED, ' +
                        ''' '' SYSTEM_DATA, ' +
				'dbo.REPGETFMTDATILOCALE( @sR5user , @sR5deforg, (dbo.REPGETSYSDATE(@sR5deforg ))) AS CURDATETIME, ' +
                        ''' '' ME_MEC, ' +
                        '''X'' DUMMY '

    begin
        set @sSQL = 'SELECT '+ coalesce(@sSelect,'') + 'FROM '+ coalesce(@sFrom,'') + 'WHERE '+ coalesce(@sWhereClause, '') + ' UNION ALL SELECT ' + @sSelectUnion + ' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM' + coalesce(@sFrom,'') + 'WHERE '+ coalesce(@sWhereClause, '') + ')' + @sOrderBy

        execute sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@sSess nvarchar(40) ,@sR5function nvarchar(6) ,@sR5user nvarchar(255) ,@sR5language nvarchar(2) ,@sR5deforg nvarchar(15)',@sSess, @sR5function, @sR5user, @sR5language, @sR5deforg
                if @@ERROR <> 0
                    return -1
    end

    set @sUpdate1 = 'Delete r5wrcala where wrc_session = ''' + @sSess + ''' '
    insert into R5TEMPRUNSQL ( TRS_USER, TRS_FUNCTION, TRS_SQL) VALUES (@sR5user , @sR5function , @sUpdate1  )	

    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 
         COMMIT

name: REPX5GETPK
tables: R5BLANKETORDERS, R5CAMPAIGNS, R5CHANGENOTICE, R5DOCKLINES, R5ENTAPPLISTS, R5EVENTS, R5INVOICES, R5MATLISTS, R5OBJECTS, R5ORDERS, R5PERMITTOWORK, R5PICKLISTS, R5PPMS, R5PRODUCTIONREQUESTS, R5PROJECTS, R5QUOTATIONS, R5REQUISITIONS, R5RFQRESPONSES, R5RFQUOTATIONS, R5TASKS, R5TRANSACTIONS
body:
create procedure REPX5GETPK @sSelent    nvarchar(4),
                            @sPk1       nvarchar(32)    OUTPUT,
                            @sPk2       nvarchar(32)    OUTPUT,
                            @sTablename nvarchar(32)    OUTPUT
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sRent      nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE
    declare @sChk       nvarchar(4)
    declare @nReturn    int

    SET @sRent = @sSelent

    if @sRent = N'PORD'
        begin
            set @sPk1 = N'ORD_CODE'
            set @sPk2 = N'ORD_ORG'
            set @sTablename = N'R5ORDERS'
        end
    if @sRent = N'BORD'
        begin
            set @sPk1 = N'BLO_BLANKETORDER'
            set @sPk2 = N'BLO_ORG'
            set @sTablename = N'R5BLANKETORDERS'
        end
    if @sRent = N'CHNO'
        begin
            set @sPk1 = N'CNH_CODE'
            set @sPk2 = N'CNH_ORG'
            set @sTablename = N'R5CHANGENOTICE'
        end
    if @sRent = N'EVNT'
        begin
            set @sPk1 = N'EVT_CODE'
            set @sPk2 = N'EVT_ORG'

create function REP_GETUDFSETUP (@sType nvarchar(5), @sField nvarchar(50),  @sEntity nvarchar(6))
returns nvarchar(255)
as
begin

    declare @sReturnval nvarchar(255)

    select TOP 1 @sReturnval = (case 
					when @sType = 'DATE' then UDF_DATETYPE 
					when @sType = 'UOM' then UDF_UOM 
					when @sType = 'NUM' then UDF_NUMBERTYPE
					when @sType = 'CURR' then UDF_CURR 
					else  UDF_PRINT end)
    from    r5userdefinedfieldsetup
    where   upper(udf_field)= upper(@sField)
    and upper(udf_rentity) = upper(@sEntity)
       
    return @sReturnval

end

create procedure SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE	@sPackage	nvarchar(32), 
										@sVariable	nvarchar(32),
										@sValue		nvarchar(2000)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL	nvarchar(2400)
	declare @sTable	nvarchar(32)
	declare @nCount	int

	SET @sTable = dbo.GET_PACKAGE_VAR_TEMP_TABLENAME()

	--create temp table if necessary
	EXEC CREATE_PACKAGE_VAR_TEMP_TABLE
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	--verify that the package / variable combo is there
	SET @sSQL = N'select @nCount = count(*) from ' + @sTable
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N' where PACKAGE_NAME	= @sPackage '
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N'   and VARIABLE_NAME	= @sVariable '

	EXEC sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCount int OUTPUT, @sPackage nvarchar(32), @sVariable nvarchar(32)', @nCount OUTPUT, @sPackage, @sVariable

	if @nCount = 1
		BEGIN
			SET @sSQL = N'update ' + @sTable + N' set VARIABLE_VALUE = @sValue '
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N' where PACKAGE_NAME	= @sPackage '
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N'   and VARIABLE_NAME	= @sVariable '
			
        	EXEC sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@sValue nvarchar(2000), @sPackage nvarchar(32), @sVariable nvarchar(32)', @sValue, @sPackage, @sVariable
		END
	else
		RAISERROR ('The package / variable combination is not valid.  Package: %s; Variable: %s.', 16, 1, @sPackage, @sVariable )

name: TO_DATE
body:
create function TO_DATE(@sDate nvarchar(64), @sFormat nvarchar(64))
returns datetime
as
begin
	declare @sNewdate	nvarchar(64)
	declare @nPos		int
	declare @sTemp		nvarchar(64)
	declare @dTemp		datetime
	declare @nTemp		int
	declare @nStyle		int
	declare @dBasedate	datetime
	declare @sBottext	nvarchar(255)
	declare @nCount		int

	--if either parameter is null then return null
	if @sDate is null or @sFormat is null
		return null

	--initialize template
	set @sNewdate = N'mm/dd/yyyy hh:mi:ss'
	set @nStyle = 101

	set @sFormat = lower( @sFormat )
	set @sDate = UPPER( @sDate )

	--remove 24 and 12 from any hh formats that are present
	set @sFormat = replace( @sFormat, N'hh24', N'hh' )
	set @sFormat = replace( @sFormat, N'hh12', N'hh' )

	--pad the long month to 9 characters
	set @sFormat = replace( @sFormat, N'month', N'month    ' )

	--determine if there are time portions to deal with
	--assume time portion is going to contain either the hh% or sssss format
	set @nPos = charindex( N'hh', @sFormat ) + 
				charindex( N'sssss', @sFormat )

	if @nPos = 0
		set @sNewdate = replace( @sNewdate, N'hh:mi:ss', N'00:00:00' )
	else
		begin
			--build time portion of new date
			set @nPos = charindex( N'sssss', @sFormat )
			if @nPos > 0
				begin
					--calculate time based on number of seconds since midnight
					set @sTemp = substring( @sDate, @nPos, 5 )
					set @nTemp = cast( @sTemp as int )
					set @dTemp = cast( N'' as datetime )
					set @dTemp = dateadd( ss, @nTemp, @dTemp )

					--get hour part
					set @nTemp = datepart( hh, @dTemp )
					set @sTemp = cast( @nTemp as nvarchar(2) )
					set @sNewdate = replace( @sNewdate, N'hh', @sTemp )

					--get minute part
					set @nTemp = datepart( mi, @dTemp )
					set @sTemp = cast( @nTemp as nvarchar(2) )
					set @sNewdate = replace( @sNewdate, N'mi', @sTemp )

					--get seconds part
					set @nTemp = datepart( ss, @dTemp )
					set @sTemp = cast( @nTemp as nvarchar(2) )
					set @sNewdate = replace( @sNewdate, N'ss', @sTemp )
				end
			else
				begin
					--get hours portion
					set @nPos = charindex( N'hh', @sFormat )

                    --check to see if time portion was part of the date passed in
                    if @nPos > len( @sDate )
                        set @sTemp = N'00'
                    else
                        begin
					        set @sTemp = substring( @sDate, @nPos, 2 )

					        --if this is a AM/PM time then convert it to 24 hour
					        set @nPos = charindex( N'AM', @sDate ) + charindex( N'A.M.', @sDate ) +
								        charindex( N'PM', @sDate ) + charindex( N'P.M.', @sDate )
					        if @nPos > 0
						        begin
							        --if AM then set 12AM hours to 00
							        set @nPos = charindex( N'AM', @sDate ) + charindex( N'A.M.', @sDate )
							        if @nPos > 0
								        begin
									        if @sTemp = N'12'
										        set @sTemp = N'00'
								        end

							        --if PM then set to 24 hours
							        set @nPos = charindex( N'PM', @sDate ) + charindex( N'P.M.', @sDate )
							        if @nPos > 0
								        begin
									        set @nTemp = cast( @sTemp as int )
									        if @nTemp < 12
										        set @nTemp = @nTemp + 12
									        set @sTemp = cast( @nTemp as nvarchar(2) )
								        end
						        end
                        end

					set @sNewdate = replace( @sNewdate, N'hh', @sTemp )

					--get minutes portion
					set @nPos = charindex( N'mi', @sFormat )
					if @nPos > 0 and @nPos <= len( @sDate )
						set @sTemp = substring( @sDate, @nPos, 2 )
					else
						set @sTemp = N'00'
					set @sNewdate = replace( @sNewdate, N'mi', @sTemp )

					--get seconds portion
					set @nPos = charindex( N'ss', @sFormat )
					if @nPos > 0 and @nPos <= len( @sDate )
						set @sTemp = substring( @sDate, @nPos, 2 )
					else
						set @sTemp = N'00'
					set @sNewdate = replace( @sNewdate, N'ss', @sTemp )
				end
		end

	--Time portion should now be complete.  Move on to date portion
	--Let's first do the year portion.  Default to 1900 if year not specified
	set @sTemp = N'1900'
	set @nPos = charindex( N'yy', @sFormat ) + 
				charindex( N'rr', @sFormat )
	if @nPos > 0
		begin
			set @nPos = charindex( N'yyyy', @sFormat ) + 
						charindex( N'rrrr', @sFormat )
			if @nPos > 0
				set @sTemp = substring( @sDate, @nPos, 4 )
			else
				begin
					set @nPos = charindex( N'yy', @sFormat )
					if @nPos > 0
						begin
							select @dTemp = CurrDate from v_getdate
							set @sTemp = left( cast( YEAR(@dTemp) as nvarchar(4) ), 2 ) + substring( @sDate, @nPos, 2 )
						end
					else
						begin
							set @nPos = charindex( N'rr', @sFormat )
							set @sTemp = substring( @sDate, @nPos, 2 )
							set @nStyle = 1
						end
				end
		end
	set @sNewdate = replace( @sNewdate, N'yyyy', @sTemp )
	set @dBasedate = convert( datetime, N'01/01/' + @sTemp, @nStyle )

	--handle the ddd format which gives both month and day
	set @nPos = charindex( N'ddd', @sFormat )
	if @nPos > 0
		begin
			--calculate the date based on the number of days since 01/01
			set @sTemp = substring( @sDate, @nPos, 3 )
			set @nTemp = cast( @sTemp as int ) - 1
			set @dTemp = dateadd( dd, @nTemp, @dBasedate )

			--get the month
			set @sTemp = cast( MONTH( @dTemp ) as nvarchar(2) )
			set @sNewdate = replace( @sNewdate, N'mm', @sTemp )

			--get the day
			set @sTemp = cast( DAY( @dTemp ) as nvarchar(2) )
			set @sNewdate = replace( @sNewdate, N'dd', @sTemp )
		end
	else
		begin
			--month and day are listed separately
			--get the day (only dd supported now)
			set @nPos = charindex( N'dd', @sFormat )
			if @nPos > 0
				set @sTemp = substring( @sDate, @nPos, 2 )
			else
				set @sTemp = N'01'
			set @sNewdate = replace( @sNewdate, N'dd', @sTemp )

			--get the month
			--default to 01
			set @sTemp = N'01'
			set @nPos = charindex( N'mm', @sFormat ) + 
						charindex( N'mon', @sFormat )
			if @nPos > 0
				begin
					--handle mm format
					set @nPos = charindex( N'mm', @sFormat )
					if @nPos > 0
						set @sTemp = substring( @sDate, @nPos, 2 )
					else
						begin
							set @nPos = charindex( N'month', @sFormat )
							if @nPos > 0
								begin
									--long month names
									set @sTemp =rtrim(substring( @sDate, @nPos, 9 ) )
									select @sBottext = bot_text 
										from r5boilertexts
										where bot_function='BSJSDN' and 
												bot_fld1='LONG_MONTHS' and
												upper(bot_text) like N'%' + @sTemp + N'%'
									--if no match is found then return the default
									if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
										set @sBottext = null
								end
							else
								begin
									--short month names

create trigger UNQINS2_APM
on R5ASPECTPROMPTS
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sAspect	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sColumn	nvarchar(35)
	declare @nCount		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select APM_ASPECT, APM_COLUMN from inserted
			open c_inserted 
			fetch next from c_inserted into @sAspect, @sColumn
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sColumn is not null
						select @nCount = count(*)
						  from R5ASPECTPROMPTS	 
						 where APM_ASPECT = @sAspect	AND
								APM_COLUMN = @sColumn
					else
						select @nCount = count(*)
						  from R5ASPECTPROMPTS	 
						 where APM_ASPECT  = @sAspect	AND
								APM_COLUMN IS NULL

					--there should be only one row returned, which is the inserted row.
					if @nCount > 1
						begin
							close c_inserted
							deallocate c_inserted
							RAISERROR( 'Error inserting row into R5ASPECTPROMPTS.  APM_ASPECT, APM_COLUMN must be unique.', 16, 1)
							rollback transaction
							return
						end
					
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sAspect, @sColumn
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

on R5OPVARIABLES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @nId		int
	declare @sCode		nvarchar(10)
	declare @nCount		int
	declare @nLocid		int
	declare @sName		nvarchar(20)
	declare @sOldCode	nvarchar(10)
	declare @nOldLocid	int
	declare @sOldName	nvarchar(20)
	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.OVD_ID, i.OVD_STORETCODE, i.OVD_LOCID, i.OVD_SHORTNAME,
														d.OVD_STORETCODE, d.OVD_LOCID, d.OVD_SHORTNAME
												  from inserted i, deleted d
												 where i.OVD_SQLIDENTITY = d.OVD_SQLIDENTITY
			open c_ins_del 
			fetch next from c_ins_del into @nId, @sCode, @nLocid, @sName, @sOldCode, @nOldLocid, @sOldName
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
						begin
							if @sCode is not null and ( @sOldCode is null or @sCode <> @sOldCode )
								begin
									select @nCount = count(*)
									  from R5OPVARIABLES	 
									 where OVD_ID not in (@nId) and
											OVD_STORETCODE = @sCode  

									if @nCount > 0 
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											RAISERROR( 'Error updating row in R5OPVARIABLES.  OVD_STORETCODE must be unique.', 16, 1)
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							if @nLocid is not null and ( @nOldLocid is null or @nLocid <> @nOldLocid )
								begin
									select @nCount = count(*)
									  from R5OPVARIABLES	 
									 where OVD_ID not in (@nId) and
											OVD_LOCID = @nLocid  

									if @nCount > 0 
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											RAISERROR( 'Error updating row in R5OPVARIABLES.  OVD_LOCID must be unique.', 16, 1)
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							if @sName is not null and ( @sOldName is null or @sName <> @sOldName )
								begin
									select @nCount = count(*)
									  from R5OPVARIABLES	 
									 where OVD_ID not in (@nId) and
											OVD_SHORTNAME = @sName  

									if @nCount > 0 
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											RAISERROR( 'Error updating row in R5OPVARIABLES.  OVD_SHORTNAME must be unique.', 16, 1)
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
						end
					
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nId, @sCode, @nLocid, @sName, @sOldCode, @nOldLocid, @sOldName
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE UPPAP1 
	@sInsupd      nvarchar(6),
	@sParta       nvarchar(30),  /*  Part A     */
	@sPartaorg    nvarchar(15),  /*  Part A Org */
	@sPartb       nvarchar(30),  /*  Part B     */
	@sPartborg    nvarchar(15),  /*  Part B Org */
	@sCompat      nvarchar(1),  /*  Compatibility flag  */
	@sChk         nvarchar(4)  OUTPUT 
AS SET NOCOUNT ON
   declare @nCount      integer
BEGIN
	set @sChk		= N'0'
	set @nCount		=  0

	IF @sInsupd  NOT IN  ( N'INS', N'UPD', N'DEL'  )
	OR @sInsupd    IS NULL
	OR @sParta    IS NULL
	OR @sPartb    IS NULL
	OR @sPartaorg IS NULL
	OR @sPartborg IS NULL
	OR @sCompat   IS NULL  
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end


	SELECT   @nCount = COUNT(*)
	FROM     r5partpart  p
	WHERE    p.pap_parta     = @sPartb
	AND      p.pap_parta_org = @sPartborg
	AND      p.pap_partb     = @sParta
	AND      p.pap_partb_org = @sPartaorg



	IF @sCompat = N'2'  
		begin
			IF @sInsupd IN (  N'INS', N'UPD' )  
				begin
					IF @nCount  =  0  
						INSERT INTO r5partpart ( pap_parta, pap_parta_org,pap_partb, pap_partb_org, pap_compat )
						VALUES ( @sPartb, @sPartborg, @sParta, @sPartaorg, @sCompat )
				end
			IF @sInsupd = N'DEL'  
				begin
					IF @nCount  =  1  
						DELETE FROM r5partpart
						WHERE  pap_parta     = @sPartb
						AND    pap_parta_org = @sPartborg
						AND    pap_partb     = @sParta
						AND    pap_partb_org = @sPartaorg
				end
		end
	ELSE
		begin
			IF @sCompat  =  N'1' 
				begin
					IF @sInsupd   =  N'UPD'  
						begin
							IF @nCount  =  1      
							DELETE FROM r5partpart
							WHERE  pap_parta     = @sPartb
							AND    pap_parta_org = @sPartborg
							AND    pap_partb     = @sParta
							AND    pap_partb_org = @sPartaorg
						end
				end
		end
END

body:
create procedure UTL_FILE_PUT_LINE @sFileHandle integer, @sOutput nvarchar(4000)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sLogFileExist		nvarchar(8)
	declare @nReturn			integer
	declare @sFileDir			nvarchar(512)
	declare @sFileName			nvarchar(256)
	declare @sFileFullPath		nvarchar(760)
	declare @sCommand			nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sTempOutput		nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sPrint				nvarchar(400)
	declare @nLenOutput			integer
	declare @nPrintLength		integer
	declare @sTemp				varchar(4000)

	--note with the xp_dstm_cmdshell we do not use a filehandle.  We use the fully qualified file path to access the log file.
	--Since these have already been set the procedure will be a stub in case we need to use the SP_OA procedures which would
	--Use the file handle.

	set @nPrintLength = 400 -- Change this variable if you want to print a different size chunck at a time...

	--Set g_fileexist to false so that the first time that UTL_FILE_PUT_LINE runs the file will be created instead of appended to.
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'UTL_FILE', N'g_LogFileExist', @sLogFileExist OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceFileDir', @sFileDir OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceFileName', @sFileName OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	
	set @sFileFullPath = @sFileDir + '\' + @sFileName 

    if @sOutput is null	--yaon: concatenate with null results null
		set @sOutput = N'null'
	
	set @sTempOutput = @sOutput
	set @sTempOutput = REPLACE(@sTempOutput, CHAR(10), ' ')
	set @sTempOutput = REPLACE(@sTempOutput, CHAR(13), ' ')

	set @nLenOutput = 1

	WHILE @nLenOutput > 0
		begin
			set @sPrint = SUBSTRING ( @sTempOutput , 1 , @nPrintLength )
			if upper(@sLogFileExist) = 'FALSE'
				begin
					set @sCommand =  N'ECHO "' + @sPrint + N'">>' + @sFileFullPath --yaon: add "" around output to solve the number issue
					set @sTemp = cast( @sCommand as varchar(4000) )
					execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_cmdshell  @sTemp
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'UTL_FILE', N'g_LogFileExist', N'True'
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sCommand = N'ECHO "' + @sPrint + N'">>' + @sFileFullPath  --yaon changed from > to >>, add "" around output
					set @sTemp = cast( @sCommand as varchar(4000) )
					execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_cmdshell  @sTemp
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							return -1
				end
			
			if len(@sTempOutput) > @nPrintLength
				set @sTempOutput = right(@sTempOutput, len(@sTempOutput) - @nPrintLength)
			else
				BREAK

			set @nLenOutput = len(@sTempOutput) 
		end

CREATE  procedure VARADDDEPENDENCY 	@nStatus numeric(38,0) OUTPUT, 
					@nVarid numeric(38,0),
                                        @nVarnum    numeric(38,0),
                                        @sEquation  nvarchar(640),
                                        @nCalcorder numeric(38,0)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @bBadequation     bit 
    declare @nMax_calcorder   numeric(38,0)
    declare @nChild_calcorder numeric(38,0)
    declare @sEquat           nvarchar(640)     --r5opvariables.ovd_eqinfix%TYPE;
    declare @nNxt             integer
    declare @nChild           numeric(38,0)
    declare @nNxtnum          integer
    declare @sTemp            nvarchar(200)
    declare @nTemp            integer
    declare @nReturn	integer
    declare @sX		nvarchar(4)
    declare @sErrorMsg	nvarchar(255)
    declare @sThisC	char
    declare @sPriorC	char

    set @sEquat = substring (@sEquation, charindex( N'EQ:', @sEquation) + 3, len(@sEquation) ) 
    set @bBadequation = 0 
    set @nMax_calcorder = 0
    set @nStatus = 0 
    set @sPriorC = '!'
    set @nNxt = 1

    /* scan equation for each referenced V## or C## (with non-alpha before V or C) */
    while (@nNxt <= len(@sEquat)) and (@bBadequation = 0)
	begin
	set @sThisC = substring(@sEquat, @nNxt, 1)
	if (@sThisC = 'C' or @sThisC = 'V') and (@sPriorC < 'A' or @sPriorC > 'Z')
		begin
		set @nNxtnum  = @nNxt + 1  /* Find ## varid until next non-numeric */
		while substring(@sEquat, @nNxtnum, 1) >= '0' and substring (@sEquat, @nNxtnum, 1) <= '9' 
			begin
			set @nNxtnum   = @nNxtnum + 1
			end
		if @nNxtnum > @nNxt+1 	/* if found any numeric, have a var reference */
			begin
			If isnumeric(substring(@sEquat, @nNxt + 1, @nNxtnum - @nNxt - 1)) = 1
				set @nChild  = cast(substring(@sEquat, @nNxt + 1, @nNxtnum - @nNxt - 1) as numeric(38,0))
			else
				begin
				set @bBadequation = 1
				set @nStatus = 1
				set @sTemp = N'Invalid variable reference in variable ' + cast(@nVarid as nvarchar(38)) + ' at position ' + cast(@nNxt as nvarchar(38))
				execute @nReturn = LOGSERVERERROR N'CALC',N'ERROR',@sTemp
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
				end
			if @bBadequation = 0 
				begin
				select @nChild_calcorder = coalesce(ovd_calcorder, 1)
					from r5opvariables
					where ovd_id = @nChild
				if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
					begin
					set @bBadequation = 1
					set @nStatus = 2
					set @sTemp = N'Invalid variable ID in variable ' + cast(@nVarid as nvarchar(38)) + ' at position ' + cast(@nNxt as nvarchar(38))
					execute @nReturn = LOGSERVERERROR N'CALC',N'ERROR',@sTemp
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1
					end
				/* save maximum calcorder level */
				if @nChild_calcorder > @nMax_calcorder 
					set @nMax_calcorder =  @nChild_calcorder
				If not exists (select 1 from r5opvardependencies where ovv_varid = @nChild and ovv_parentid = @nVarid)
					begin
					insert into r5opvardependencies  (ovv_varid, ovv_parentid)
							values (@nChild, @nVarid)
					if @@ERROR <> 0 
						begin
						set @bBadequation = 1
						set @nStatus = 2
						set @sTemp = N'Invalid variable ID in variable ' + cast(@nVarid as nvarchar(38)) + ' at position ' + cast(@nNxt as nvarchar(38))
						execute @nReturn = LOGSERVERERROR N'CALC',N'ERROR',@sTemp
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							return -1
						end
					end
				end
			set @nNxt = @nNxtnum - 1
			set @sThisC = '#'
			end
		end                     
        set @nNxt  = @nNxt + 1
        set @sPriorC = @sThisC
        end                             
    If @bBadequation = 0 
	begin
	/* Check for circular references */
	if dbo.VarCircularCheck(@nVarid, @nVarid) = 1 
		begin
		set @bBadequation = 1
		set @nStatus = 3
		/*     translate message: 'Circular reference found for variable V:PARM1.' */
		execute @nReturn = o7intgem @sErrorMsg OUTPUT, N'VARADD',N'PROC',3
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		set @sErrorMsg = REPLACE( @sErrorMsg, N':PARM1', cast(@nVarid as nvarchar(38)))
		execute @nReturn = LOGSERVERERROR N'CALC',N'ERROR',@sErrorMsg
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		end
	end

    if @bBadequation = 0 
        begin
	/* for this var and all parents, increase calcorder if less than this @nMax_calcorder */
	set @nTemp  = @nMax_calcorder + 1
	execute @nReturn = VARSETORDER @nVarid, @nCalcorder, @nTemp
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
        end
    Else
        set @sX = null

CREATE function VARCIRCULARCHECK ( @nRootvarid  numeric(38,0), 
                           @nVarid              numeric(38,0)) 
returns bit
as
 
BEGIN
    declare @bBit       bit

    declare @nOvdId         numeric(38,0)

    declare c_var cursor local for select v.ovd_id from r5opvariables v, r5opvardependencies d
                                where d.ovv_parentid = @nVarid and d.ovv_varid=v.ovd_id and 
                                ovd_facttype = 0 AND ovd_vartype = '9'

    open c_var
    fetch next from c_var into @nOvdId
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	    begin

             if @nRootvarid = @nOvdId 
				begin
				    close c_var
					deallocate c_var
					return 1
				end
             else
                begin
                    if dbo.VarCircularCheck(@nRootvarid, @nOvdId)  = 1
					begin
						close c_var
						deallocate c_var
						return 1
					end
                end
            fetch next from c_var into @nOvdId
        end

    close c_var
    deallocate c_var
    return 0 

END

CREATE  procedure VARRESETDEPENDENCIES	
as

SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @nOvdid             numeric(38,0)
    declare @nOvdvarnum         numeric(38,0)
    declare @sOvdeqinfix        nvarchar(640)
    declare @nOvdcalorder       numeric(38,0)
    declare @nReturn            integer
	declare @nStatus			integer


    DELETE FROM r5opvardependencies 

    UPDATE r5opvariables
    SET ovd_calcorder = 1
    WHERE ovd_facttype = 0
    AND ovd_vartype = '9'

    /* For every 7.9 calculated variable: add dependencies */
    declare c_var cursor local for SELECT ovd_id,
                                        ovd_varnum,
                                        ovd_eqinfix,
                                        coalesce(ovd_calcorder, 1) calcorder
                                    FROM r5opvariables
                                    WHERE ovd_facttype = 0
                                    AND ovd_vartype = '9'

    open c_var
    fetch next from c_var into @nOvdid, @nOvdvarnum, @sOvdeqinfix, @nOvdcalorder
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	    begin

            execute @nReturn = VarAddDependency @nStatus OUTPUT, @nOvdid,@nOvdvarnum, @sOvdeqinfix, @nOvdcalorder
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		    begin
                close c_var
	            deallocate c_var
                return -1
            end

            fetch next from c_var into @nOvdid, @nOvdvarnum, @sOvdeqinfix, @nOvdcalorder
        end

    close c_var
    deallocate c_var

name: VARSETORDER

CREATE procedure VARSETORDER	@nNode         numeric(38,0),
                                @nCalcorder    numeric(38,0),
                                @nMaxcalcorder numeric(38,0)
as

SET NOCOUNT ON

declare @nReturn                integer
declare @nParentid              numeric(38,0)
declare @nParentCalcoder        numeric(38,0)
declare @nTemp                  numeric(38,0)

    IF @nCalcorder < @nMaxcalcorder 
        begin
            /* Don't do anything if already above the passed max calcorder */
            UPDATE r5opvariables
            SET ovd_calcorder = @nMaxcalcorder
            WHERE ovd_id = @nNode

            /*  Find all parents of this node. If none, we are done */
            declare c_parent cursor local for SELECT ovv_parentid, ovd_calcorder
                    FROM r5opvardependencies, r5opvariables
                    WHERE ovv_varid = @nNode
                    AND ovv_parentid = ovd_id

            open c_parent
            fetch next from c_parent into @nParentid, @nParentCalcoder      
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	            begin
                    set @nTemp  = @nMaxcalcorder + 1
                    execute @nReturn = VarSetOrder @nParentid,@nParentCalcoder , @nTemp
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		            begin
                        close c_parent
	                    deallocate c_parent
                        return -1
                    end
                    fetch next from c_parent into @nParentid, @nParentCalcoder  
                end

            close c_parent
            deallocate c_parent
        end

CREATE PROCEDURE WDRV @sV_tenant nvarchar(255)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON
    declare  @nVtimeout          			 numeric(38,2)
    declare  @nNstop             			 int
    declare  @nJobid             			 int
    declare  @sTenant_statement              nvarchar(2000)
    declare  @sTenant_password               nvarchar(20)
    declare  @sTenant_customer               nvarchar(30)
    declare  @nTenant_id                     int
	declare  @bLock_exclusive 				 bit
	declare  @bGet_dashboardetlflag 		 bit
	declare  @nSel_error 					 int
	declare  @nIns_error 					 int
	declare  @nReturn						 int
	declare  @sTempvar						 nvarchar(2000)
	declare  @dNextdate						 datetime
	declare  @sVrundashboardetl				 nvarchar(1)	
	declare  @sNdeforg						 nvarchar(30)
	declare  @sChk							 nvarchar(5)

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sNdeforg OUTPUT, N'PRODUCTS', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	IF UPPER( @sNdeforg ) = N'D7I'
	begin
		--the first if block is dead code because none of the values calculated are used.
	  
		execute @nReturn = DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO_Set_Module N'WDRV', N'Starting' 
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	
		set @bLock_exclusive = 1
		if not exists ( select 'x' from r5install where ins_code = N'~WDRV~' )
			begin
				INSERT INTO r5install (ins_code,ins_desc,ins_comment,ins_fixed)
				VALUES (  N'~WDRV~',
						  N'RUNNING ' + cast( dbo.o7gttime2(null) as nvarchar(80) ),
						  N'Dashboard and data warehouse driver',
						  N'-'
					   )
				if @@ERROR <> 0
					set @bLock_exclusive = 0
				else
					commit
			end
	
	    IF @bLock_exclusive = 1
		begin
			SELECT @nVtimeout = cast(ins_desc as numeric(38,0))
	  		FROM   r5install
	  		WHERE  ins_code = N'WHSLEEP'
	
			IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
				set @nVtimeout = 24 --hours
	
		    set @nNstop = 0
	
			execute @nReturn = DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO_Set_Module N'WDRV', N'Processing' 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF UPPER( @sNdeforg ) = N'D7I'
			begin
		    	SELECT @nNstop = COUNT(1)
		    	FROM   r5install
		    	WHERE  ins_code = N'~SWDRV~'
			end

			if @nNstop = 0
				begin
					execute O7LDW_P_MAINTAIN_R5DWORGFACT_TBL 
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

	  				COMMIT	
	  			end
				
		    IF @nNstop != 0 
			begin
				DELETE
				FROM r5install
				WHERE ins_code LIKE '%WDRV%'
				COMMIT
			end
		    ELSE
			begin
				set @sTempvar = N'WDRV('''+ @sV_tenant +''')'
				set @dNextdate = DATEADD(ss, @nVtimeout, getdate() )
		        execute @nReturn = DBMS_JOB_SUBMIT @nJobid OUTPUT, @sTempvar, @dNextdate
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					Return -1
		        commit
		    end
		end
	    ELSE 	
	    begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'WDRV', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		end
	
		execute @nReturn = DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO_Set_Module N'WDRV', N'Exiting' 
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	end
	else
		begin
			IF UPPER( @sNdeforg ) = N'D7I'
			begin
		    	SELECT @nNstop = COUNT(1)
		    	FROM   r5install
		    	WHERE  ins_code = N'~SWDRV~'
			end

			if @nNstop = 0
				begin
					execute O7LDW_P_MAINTAIN_R5DWORGFACT_TBL 
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1
		
	  				COMMIT	
				end
		end

create procedure XMLCHKDBTRAN	@nReturn	int OUTPUT,
								@sMypid		nvarchar(128), 
								@sPid		nvarchar(128),
								@sIstimer	nvarchar(1)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

	declare @sBaseqrystr	nvarchar(3000)
	declare @sTimestr		nvarchar(100)
	declare @sSincetime		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sStatement		nvarchar(4000)
	declare @nDone			int
	declare @nError			int
	declare @nPending		int

	declare @dSincetime		datetime

	select @sBaseqrystr = grd_basequery from r5grid where grd_gridname = N'DSTRAN'
	if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
		begin
			set @nReturn = 1
			return
		end

	if @sIstimer = N'+'
		begin
			set @sTimestr = N' AND TIMESTAMP >= dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( GetDate(), -6)'
			set @dSincetime = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( GetDate(), -6)
			set @sSincetime =  cast( @dSincetime as nvarchar(30) )
		end
	else
		begin
			select @sSincetime = cast( dbs_transince as nvarchar(30) ) from r5databridgestatus
			if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
				begin
					set @nReturn = 2
					return
				end

			if @sSincetime is null
				begin
					set @sTimestr = N' AND TIMESTAMP >= dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( GetDate(), -6 )'
					set @dSincetime = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( GetDate(), -6 )
					set @sSincetime =  cast( @dSincetime as nvarchar(30) )
				end
			else
				set @sTimestr = N' AND TIMESTAMP >= cast( ''' + @sSincetime + N''' as datetime )'
		end

	set @sBaseqrystr = replace( @sBaseqrystr, N':parameter.mypid',N'''' + @sMypid + N'''')
	set @sBaseqrystr = replace( @sBaseqrystr, N':parameter.pid',N'''' + @sPid + N'''')

	set @sStatement = N'select @nOutput = count(*) ' + @sBaseqrystr + N' AND STATUS = @sStatus' + @sTimestr

	execute sp_executesql @sStatement, N'@nOutput int OUTPUT, @sStatus nvarchar(30)', @nDone OUTPUT, N'DONE'
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		begin
			set @nReturn = 3
			return
		end

	execute sp_executesql @sStatement, N'@nOutput int OUTPUT, @sStatus nvarchar(30)', @nError OUTPUT, N'ERROR'
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		begin
			set @nReturn = 3
			return
		end

	execute sp_executesql @sStatement, N'@nOutput int OUTPUT, @sStatus nvarchar(30)', @nPending OUTPUT, N'PENDING'
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		begin
			set @nReturn = 3
			return
		end

    UPDATE R5DATABRIDGESTATUS
    SET DBS_NUMOFDONE = @nDone,
        DBS_NUMOFERROR = @nError,
        DBS_NUMOFPENDING = @nPending,
        DBS_TRANSINCE = cast(@sSincetime as datetime),
        DBS_TRANASOF = GetDate()
	
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		begin
			set @nReturn = 4
			return
		end
	
	commit

	set @nReturn = 0
