create trigger XMLOUT_POSDEL_ADD 
on R5ADDETAILS
for delete NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sFlag		nvarchar(2)
	declare @sRentity	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCode		nvarchar(100)
	declare @nCount		int
	declare @sSQL		nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sTempMsgid	nvarchar(256)
	declare @nReturn	integer
	
	declare @sOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sPartOrg		nvarchar(2000)
	
	declare @sEvtCode		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEventRstatus		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sEventRtype		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sJobtype		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sJobrtype		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sParentEvent		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEventOut		nvarchar(30)
	declare @dEventInterface	datetime
	declare @sExportwo              nvarchar(30)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select ADD_CODE, ADD_RENTITY from deleted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sRentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
					begin				
				
					   if @sRentity = N'EVNT'
					   begin
					   	select @sFlag = coalesce( INS_DESC, N'N') from r5install where ins_code = N'@SYNCWO'
					   	if @sFlag = N'Y' or @sFlag = N'A'
					   	begin
					   		if CHARINDEX(N'#', @sCode) > 0
					   			set @sEvtCode = SUBSTRING(@sCode, 1, CHARINDEX(N'#', @sCode) - 1)
					   		else
					   			set @sEvtCode = @sCode
					   
					   		select	@sEventRstatus = evt_rstatus,
								@sEventRtype = evt_rtype,
								@sJobtype = evt_jobtype,
								@sParentEvent = evt_parent,
								@sOrg = evt_org,
								@dEventInterface = evt_interface
								from r5events 
								where evt_code = @sEvtCode
					   
					   		if (@sEventRtype = N'JOB' or @sEventRtype = N'PPM') and ( @sEventRstatus = N'C' or @sEventRstatus = N'R' or @sEventRstatus = N'Q')
							begin
					   			set @sExportwo = N'Y'
								if @sEventRstatus = N'Q'
									select @sExportwo = isnull( INS_DESC, N'N' ) from r5install where INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWOQ'
                                                                   
					   			if @sExportwo = N'Y'
                                                                begin
 									select @sJobrtype = uco_rcode
									from r5ucodes
									where uco_rentity = N'JBTP' and uco_code= @sJobtype
								    
									if @sJobrtype in ( N'*', N'BR', N'ST', N'PM', N'CAL', N'RP', N'MEC')
									begin
										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
										
										if @sParentEvent is not null and @sJobrtype = N'MEC'
										begin
											set @sEventOut = @sParentEvent
											select @dEventInterface = evt_interface from r5events where evt_code=@sParentEvent
										end
										else
											set @sEventOut = @sEvtCode										
										
										INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
										(XTS_TRANTYPE,
										XTS_TABLE,
										XTS_KEYFLD1,
										XTS_KEYFLD2,
										XTS_ORG,
										XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
										)
										SELECT
										N'SYNCMAINTORDER',
										N'R5EVENTS',
										@sEventOut,
										CASE WHEN @dEventInterface IS NULL THEN N'A' ELSE N'R' END,
										@sOrg,
										@sTempMsgid
										WHERE NOT EXISTS(select 1 from r5xmltranstatus where xts_trantype=N'SYNCMAINTORDER' and xts_keyfld1=@sEventOut)
									end                                                               
                                                                
					   			end
					   		end
					   	end
					   end
					   else if @sRentity = N'PART' or @sRentity = N'STOC' or @sRentity = N'TRAD'
					   begin
						select @nCount = count(*) from r5install where ins_code = N'@SYNCITM'
						if @nCount = 0 
							set @sFlag = N'N'
						else
							select @sFlag = coalesce( INS_DESC, N'N') from r5install where ins_code = N'@SYNCITM'

						if @sFlag = N'Y' or @sFlag = N'T'
							begin
							
									if @sRentity = N'PART' or (@sRentity = N'STOC' and @sFlag = N'T')
										begin


											EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_deleted
													deallocate c_deleted
													rollback transaction
													return
												end

											set @sPartOrg = SUBSTRING(@sCode, CHARINDEX(N'#', @sCode) + 1, 2000)
											if CHARINDEX(N'#', @sPartOrg) > 0
											    set @sPartOrg = SUBSTRING(@sPartOrg, 1, CHARINDEX(N'#', @sPartOrg) - 1)

											set @sSQL = N'INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
																(XTS_TRANTYPE,
																XTS_TABLE,
																XTS_KEYFLD1,
																XTS_KEYFLD2,
																XTS_KEYFLD3,
																XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID,
																XTS_ORG
																)
														SELECT	N''SYNCITEM'',																
																N''R5PARTS'', N''' + 
																SUBSTRING(@sCode, 1, CHARINDEX(N'#', @sCode) - 1) + N''', N''' +
																@sPartOrg + N''', N''R'', N''' + 
																coalesce(@sTempMsgid, N'') + N''', N''' + 
																@sPartOrg + N'''
														WHERE NOT EXISTS(select 1 from r5xmltranstatus where xts_trantype=N''SYNCITEM'' and xts_keyfld1=N''' + 
																SUBSTRING(@sCode, 1, CHARINDEX(N'#', @sCode) - 1) + N''' and xts_keyfld2 = N''' + @sPartOrg + N''')'
											EXEC(@sSQL) 
										end
									
									
							end
						
						
						if @sFlag = N'T'
							begin
							
									if @sRentity = N'TRAD'
										begin


											EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_deleted
													deallocate c_deleted
													rollback transaction
													return
												end

											select @sOrg = TRD_ORG from r5trades where trd_code = @sCode
																			
											set @sSQL = N'INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
															(XTS_TRANTYPE,
															XTS_TABLE,
															XTS_KEYFLD1,
															XTS_KEYFLD2,
															XTS_KEYFLD3,
															XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID,
															XTS_ORG
															)
															VALUES(	N''SYNCITEM'',
															N''R5TRADES'', N''' + 
															@sCode + N''', N''' +
															@sOrg + N''', N''R'',N''' + 
															coalesce(@sTempMsgid, N'') + N''',N''' + @sOrg + N''')'
											EXEC(@sSQL) 
										end
									
									
							end
					   end
					   
					   fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @sRentity
					end	
					close c_deleted	
						
						
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin

create trigger XMLOUT_POSDEL_XTS
on R5XMLTRANSTATUS
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUsr_name	nvarchar(38)
	declare @sChk		nvarchar(3)
	declare @nSeqnum	int
	declare @dToday		datetime
	declare @dCreate	datetime
	declare @sTrantype	nvarchar(16)
	declare @sTable		nvarchar(32)
	declare @sKeyfld1	nvarchar(80)
	declare @sKeyfld2	nvarchar(80)
	declare @sKeyfld3	nvarchar(80)
	declare @sKeyfld4	nvarchar(80)
	declare @sKeyfld5	nvarchar(80)
	declare @dKeydate1	datetime
	declare @dKeydate2	datetime
	declare @sDatafld1	nvarchar(80)
	declare @sDatafld2	nvarchar(80)
	declare @sDatafld3	nvarchar(80)
	declare @sMessage	nvarchar(500)
	declare @sOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn	int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select	XTS_SEQNUM, XTS_CREATE, XTS_TRANTYPE, XTS_TABLE, 
														XTS_KEYFLD1, XTS_KEYFLD2, XTS_KEYFLD3, XTS_KEYFLD4, XTS_KEYFLD5,
														XTS_KEYFLDDATE1, XTS_KEYFLDDATE2,
														XTS_DATAFLD1, XTS_DATAFLD2, XTS_DATAFLD3, 
														XTS_MESSAGE, XTS_ORG from deleted
			set @sUsr_name = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUsr_name <> N'SYS'
			begin					
				open c_deleted
				fetch next from c_deleted into @nSeqnum, @dCreate, @sTrantype, @sTable, 
												@sKeyfld1, @sKeyfld2, @sKeyfld3, @sKeyfld4, @sKeyfld5,
												@dKeydate1, @dKeydate2, @sDatafld1, @sDatafld2, @sDatafld3,
												@sMessage, @sOrg
				while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
					begin
						--posdel portion
						if exists ( select 1 FROM r5databridgeerrors
									WHERE dbe_glprocess = @sTable
									AND dbe_xtsseqnum = @nSeqnum )
							DELETE FROM r5databridgeerrors
							WHERE dbe_glprocess = @sTable
								AND dbe_xtsseqnum = @nSeqnum
						
								--xmlout portion
								set @dToday = GETDATE()

								-- insert deleted row into history table
  								insert into R5XMLTRANSTATUSHIST (	XTH_SEQNUM, XTH_CREATE, XTH_TRANTYPE, XTH_TABLE, 
																XTH_KEYFLD1, XTH_KEYFLD2, XTH_KEYFLD3, XTH_KEYFLD4, XTH_KEYFLD5,
																XTH_KEYFLDDATE1, XTH_KEYFLDDATE2,
																XTH_DATAFLD1, XTH_DATAFLD2, XTH_DATAFLD3, XTH_ORG,
																XTH_MESSAGE, XTH_ARCHIVE )
									values (	@nSeqnum, @dCreate, @sTrantype, @sTable, 
												@sKeyfld1, @sKeyfld2, @sKeyfld3, @sKeyfld4, @sKeyfld5,
												@dKeydate1, @dKeydate2, @sDatafld1, @sDatafld2, @sDatafld3, @sOrg,
												@sMessage, @dToday )
				
						fetch next from c_deleted into @nSeqnum, @dCreate, @sTrantype, @sTable, 
														@sKeyfld1, @sKeyfld2, @sKeyfld3, @sKeyfld4, @sKeyfld5,
														@dKeydate1, @dKeydate2, @sDatafld1, @sDatafld2, @sDatafld3,
														@sMessage, @sOrg
					end
				close c_deleted
			end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

                from inserted i
			
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()

as

    declare @nCount         integer
    declare @sFlag          nvarchar(1)

    declare @sTempMsgid     nvarchar(256)

    declare @sOldExternCode     nvarchar(256)

        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_ins_del cursor local for 
                select  i.usr_code, i.usr_emailaddress, i.usr_externcode, d.usr_code, d.usr_emailaddress, d.usr_externcode 
                from inserted i full outer join deleted d on i.usr_sqlidentity = d.usr_sqlidentity
                
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SECUSER'
                    if @nCount > 0
                        select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SECUSER'

                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            if @sFlag = N'Y'
                                begin
                                    set @sSyncIndicator = N'R'
                                    if @sUsrCode is null
                                        begin
                                            set @sSyncIndicator = N'D'
                                            set @sUsrCode = @sOldUsrCode
                                            set @sEmail = @sOldEmail
                                            set @sExternCode = @sOldExternCode
                                        end
                                        
                                    if ( not (@sEmail is null and @sExternCode is null ) ) and
                                            ( not ( @sSyncIndicator = N'D' and (@sExternCode is null) )  )
                                        begin
                                        
                                            EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
                                                                                    
                                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                                begin
                                                    close c_ins_del
                                                    deallocate c_ins_del
                                                    rollback transaction
                                                    return
                                                end
                                         
                                            if (@sSyncIndicator = N'D')
                                                begin
                                                    DELETE FROM r5xmltranstatus where xts_trantype=N'SECUSER' and xts_keyfld1=@sUsrCode
                                                end

                                                xts_trantype,
                                                xts_table,
                                                xts_keyfld1,
                                                xts_keyfld2,
                                                xts_orig_messageid)
                                            SELECT
                                                N'SECUSER',
                                                N'R5USERS',
                                                @sUsrCode,
                                                @sSyncIndicator,
                                                @sTempMsgid
                                            WHERE NOT EXISTS(select 1 from r5xmltranstatus where xts_trantype=N'SECUSER' and xts_keyfld1=@sUsrCode and xts_keyfld2 = @sSyncIndicator)
                                        end
                                end
                            fetch next from c_ins_del into @sUsrCode, @sEmail, @sExternCode, @sOldUsrCode, @sOldEmail, @sOldExternCode
                        end
                    close c_ins_del
                    deallocate c_ins_del
                end
        end

    declare @nCountit          integer
    declare @sPrdReq           nvarchar(6)
    declare @nReturn           integer
    declare @sTempMsgid        nvarchar(256)

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_ins_del cursor local for 
                select  i.prq_code, i.prq_revision, i.prq_desc, i.prq_org, i.prq_status, i.prq_rstatus, i.prq_event, i.prq_accountingentity, i.prq_enterpriselocation, i.prq_productionorder, i.prq_priority, i.prq_prodrequeststart, i.prq_productionstart, i.prq_prodrequestend, i.prq_productionend, i.prq_updatecount,i.prq_sqlidentity,
								   					   d.prq_desc, d.prq_org, d.prq_status, d.prq_rstatus, d.prq_event, d.prq_accountingentity, d.prq_enterpriselocation, d.prq_productionorder, d.prq_priority, d.prq_prodrequeststart, d.prq_productionstart, d.prq_prodrequestend, d.prq_productionend, d.prq_updatecount
                from inserted i, deleted d
                where i.prq_sqlidentity = d.prq_sqlidentity
			
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    open c_ins_del 
                    fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sPrqCode, @nRevision, @sPrqDesc, @sPrqOrg, @sStatus, @sRStatus, @sWorkOrder, @sAccEntity, @sEntLocation, @sProdOrder, @sProdPriority, @dProdReqStart, @dProdStart, @dProdReqEnd, @dProdEnd, @nUpdatecount,@nSqlidentity,
			                                @sOldPrqDesc, @sOldPrqOrg, @sOldStatus, @sOldRStatus, @sOldWorkOrder, @sOldAccEntity, @sOldEntLocation, @sOldProdOrder, @sOldProdPriority, @dOldProdReqStart, @dOldProdStart, @dOldProdReqEnd, @dOldProdEnd, @nOldUpdatecount
            
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            --BEGIN XMLOUT_POSUPD_PRQ
                            SET @sPrdReq = N'N'
                        
                            SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*) FROM r5install WHERE ins_code = N'@PRDREQ'
							
                            IF @nCountit > 0
                                SELECT @sPrdReq = ISNULL(ins_desc, N'N') FROM r5install WHERE ins_code = N'@PRDREQ'

                            EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
			
                                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                    begin
                                        close c_ins_del
                                        deallocate c_ins_del
                                        rollback transaction
                                        return
                                    end

                            IF UPPER(@sPrdReq) = N'Y'
                                BEGIN
                                    IF (@sOldRStatus <> N'A' AND @sRStatus = N'A') 
                                        OR  (@sOldRStatus <> N'C' AND @sRStatus = N'C')
                                        OR  (@sOldRStatus <> N'S' AND @sRStatus = N'S')
                                        OR  (@sOldRStatus <> N'K' AND @sRStatus = N'K')
                                        BEGIN
                                            DELETE R5XMLTRANSTATUS
                                                WHERE XTS_TRANTYPE = N'PRDREQ'
                                                AND XTS_TABLE = N'R5PRODUCTIONREQUESTS'
                                                AND XTS_KEYFLD1 = @sPrqCode
                                                AND XTS_KEYFLD2 = @nRevision
                                                AND XTS_KEYFLD3 = @sPrqOrg

                                            INSERT INTO r5xmltranstatus 
                                                (xts_trantype, xts_table, 
                                                xts_keyfld1, xts_keyfld2, 
                                                xts_keyfld3, 
                                                xts_org,
                                                XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID)
                                            VALUES (N'PRDREQ', 
                                                N'R5PRODUCTIONREQUESTS', 
                                                @sPrqCode, 
                                                @nRevision, 
                                                @sPrqOrg, 
                                                @sPrqOrg, 
                                                @sTempMsgid)
                                        END
                                    END
                            -- END XMLOUT_POSUPD_PRQ;
				
                        fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sPrqCode, @nRevision, @sPrqDesc, @sPrqOrg, @sStatus, @sRStatus, @sWorkOrder, @sAccEntity, @sEntLocation, @sProdOrder, @sProdPriority, @dProdReqStart, @dProdStart, @dProdReqEnd, @dProdEnd, @nUpdatecount,@nSqlidentity,
			                                @sOldPrqDesc, @sOldPrqOrg, @sOldStatus, @sOldRStatus, @sOldWorkOrder, @sOldAccEntity, @sOldEntLocation, @sOldProdOrder, @sOldProdPriority, @dOldProdReqStart, @dOldProdStart, @dOldProdReqEnd, @dOldProdEnd, @nOldUpdatecount
                    end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end
    end

create trigger XMLOUT_PREDEL_RES
on R5RESERVATIONS
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sPart			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sPartorg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sStore			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(2)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sQty			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sAllQty		nvarchar(80)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nAllQty		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)	


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select RES_EVENT, RES_ACT, RES_PART, RES_PART_ORG, RES_STORE,RES_QTY,RES_ALLQTY  from deleted
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_deleted 
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sEvent, @nAct, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sStore, @nQty, @nAllQty
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							/* S3838 - Delete dependant data */
							
							select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCRES'
							if @nCount > 0 
								select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCRES'
							else
								set @sFlag = N'N'

							set @sQty = Cast(@nQty as nvarchar(80))
							set @sAllQty = Cast(@nAllQty as nvarchar(80)) /* zrn - 12/27/01 - PVCS #521*/

							if @sFlag = N'Y'
								begin
									EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_deleted
											deallocate c_deleted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
										  (XTS_TRANTYPE,
										   XTS_TABLE,
										   XTS_KEYFLD1,
										   XTS_KEYFLD2,
										   XTS_KEYFLD3,
										   XTS_KEYFLD4,
										   XTS_KEYFLD5,
										   XTS_DATAFLD1,
										   XTS_DATAFLD2,
										   XTS_DATAFLD3,
										   XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID,
										   XTS_ORG									     
										  )
										  VALUES(N'RESERVATIONS',
										  N'R5RESERVATIONS',
										  @sEvent,
										  @nAct,
										  @sPart,
										  @sPartorg,
										  @sStore,
										  N'D',
										  @sQty,
										  @sAllQty,
										  @sTempMsgid,
										  @sPartorg
										  )
								end
							fetch next from c_deleted into @sEvent, @nAct, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sStore, @nQty, @nAllQty
						end
					close c_deleted
				end
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

create trigger XMLOUT_PREINS_XTS
on R5XMLTRANSTATUS
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUsr_name		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nSeqnum		int
	declare @dCreate		datetime
	declare @sTrantype		nvarchar(16)
	declare @sTable			nvarchar(32)
	declare @sKeyfld1		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sKeyfld2		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sKeyfld3		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sKeyfld4		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sKeyfld5		nvarchar(80)
	declare @dKeydate1		datetime
	declare @dKeydate2		datetime
	declare @sDatafld1		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sDatafld2		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sDatafld3		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sMessage		nvarchar(500)
	declare @nRetry			int
	declare @nUpdatecount	int
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrgMessageid	nvarchar(60) 
	declare @nReturn		int

	declare @sDummy1		nvarchar(250)
	declare @sDummy2		nvarchar(250)
	declare @sKeyfld		nvarchar(500)
	declare @nCkresult		int
	declare @nI				int
	declare @sTemp			nvarchar(64)
	
	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	XTS_SEQNUM, XTS_CREATE, XTS_TRANTYPE, XTS_TABLE, 
														XTS_KEYFLD1, XTS_KEYFLD2, XTS_KEYFLD3, XTS_KEYFLD4, XTS_KEYFLD5,
														XTS_KEYFLDDATE1, XTS_KEYFLDDATE2,
														XTS_DATAFLD1, XTS_DATAFLD2, XTS_DATAFLD3, 
														XTS_MESSAGE, XTS_RETRY, XTS_UPDATECOUNT, XTS_ORG, XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID from inserted
			set @sUsr_name = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into @nSeqnum, @dCreate, @sTrantype, @sTable, 
											@sKeyfld1, @sKeyfld2, @sKeyfld3, @sKeyfld4, @sKeyfld5,
											@dKeydate1, @dKeydate2, @sDatafld1, @sDatafld2, @sDatafld3,
											@sMessage, @nRetry, @nUpdatecount, @sOrg,@sOrgMessageid
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUsr_name <> N'SYS'
						begin
							--xmlout portion
							if @nSeqnum is null or @nSeqnum = 0 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nSeqnum OUTPUT, N'XTS', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									else
									set @dCreate = GETUTCDATE()
								end

						end
					
					--preinsupd portion
					--Notice that this is not part of the sysuser check

					if @sTrantype = N'POSTJOURNAL'
						begin
							set @sKeyfld = SUBSTRING(N'Key1 :' + coalesce(@sKeyfld1, N'1') + N'Key2 :' + coalesce(@sKeyfld2, N'2') +
													 N'Key3 :' + coalesce(@sKeyfld3, N'3') + N'Key4 :' + coalesce(@sKeyfld4, N'4') +
													 N'Key5 :' + coalesce(@sKeyfld5, N'5'),1,500)

							--do the sequence thing again (sure, why not?)
							if @nSeqnum is null or @nSeqnum = 0 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nSeqnum OUTPUT, N'XTS', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									else
									set @dCreate = GETDATE()
								end

							execute @nReturn = o7glrowct @sDummy1 OUTPUT, @sDummy2 OUTPUT, @sTable, @nCkresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							set @sTemp = cast( @nCkresult as nvarchar(64) )

							execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_totentries', @sTemp
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
								
							execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7XMLVAL', N'v_trantype', N'POSTJOURNAL'
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @nCkresult > 0
								begin
									--workaround for direct recursion issue in SQL 2005
									insert into O7GLPROCESS_TBL values ( @sTable, @nSeqnum, @sKeyfld, @sOrg ) 
								end
						end

					insert into R5XMLTRANSTATUS (	XTS_SEQNUM, XTS_CREATE, XTS_TRANTYPE, XTS_TABLE, 
													XTS_KEYFLD1, XTS_KEYFLD2, XTS_KEYFLD3, XTS_KEYFLD4, XTS_KEYFLD5,
													XTS_KEYFLDDATE1, XTS_KEYFLDDATE2,
													XTS_DATAFLD1, XTS_DATAFLD2, XTS_DATAFLD3, 
													XTS_MESSAGE, XTS_RETRY, XTS_UPDATECOUNT, XTS_ORG, XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID )
						values (	@nSeqnum, @dCreate, @sTrantype, @sTable, 
									@sKeyfld1, @sKeyfld2, @sKeyfld3, @sKeyfld4, @sKeyfld5,
									@dKeydate1, @dKeydate2, @sDatafld1, @sDatafld2, @sDatafld3,
									@sMessage, @nRetry, @nUpdatecount, @sOrg, @sOrgMessageid )
					fetch next from c_inserted into @nSeqnum, @dCreate, @sTrantype, @sTable, 
													@sKeyfld1, @sKeyfld2, @sKeyfld3, @sKeyfld4, @sKeyfld5,
													@dKeydate1, @dKeydate2, @sDatafld1, @sDatafld2, @sDatafld3,
													@sMessage, @nRetry, @nUpdatecount, @sOrg, @sOrgMessageid
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end
